publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Next-generation sequencing can preliminarily solve many problems in the biological area and it plays a more and more important role in bioinformatics. An important step of next-generation sequencing is mapping the query reads to a long reference DNA sequence. Nevertheless, many existing read alignment tools do not have high mapping accuracy. BWA-MEM is one of the most popular tools used for mapping short reads to reference sequences and it can be considered a good read alignment tool with high accuracy. In this paper, we focus on designing a high accuracy short reads alignment system utilizing the read mapping algorithm based upon seed-and-extend type hash tables. To replace the BWA-MEM, we present a heterogeneous computing platform to construct our hash based mapping system and put forward new algorithms to replace corresponding BWA-MEM algorithms. Our system consists of a host processor to execute logical operations, and a coprocessor FPGA to accelerate computation speed. In addition, we experiment on our proposed method and compare the precision with related BWA-MEM methods. The experiment results show that we achieve more than 99 percent similarity of the intermediate results and 99.90 percent similarity of the final results with BWA-MEM. Finally, the comparison demonstrates that both BWA-MEM and our hash based mapping system can get the same output without the random selection.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Subway Station Emergency Evacuation Based on Improved Social Force Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to study the effect of panic state combined with small group behavior on the evacuation efficiency of Metro Emergency crowd. This paper introduces the panic emotion factor based on the classical social force. We modify the expected speed to improve the expected speed of small groups. We build a social force model of small group effect under panic behavior, and take an accident of a subway station as an example for group simulation evaluation. The improved model is more close to the actual situation of Group Evacuation pedestrian movement, which has guiding significance for Metro emergency evacuation.

articleTitle: Variational Auto-Encoder for text generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Many different methods to text generation have been introduced in the past. Recurrent neural network language(RNNLM) is powerful and scalable for text generation in unsupervised generative modeling. We extended the RNNLM and propose the Variational Auto-Encoder Recurrent Neural Network(VAE-RNNLM), which designed to explicitly capture such global features as continuous latent variable. Maximum likelihood learning in such a model presents an intractable inference problem. VAE-RNNLM circumvents these difficulties by using the architecture of the latest advance in variational inference to introduce a practical training technique for powerful neural network generative models with latent variables. In this paper, we using VAE-RNNLM for text generation and achieved good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Environmental Factors Affecting RFID Reading Performance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the internet of things (IOT), automatic identification technology has been applied widely. As the key of IOT, radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has played an important role. In practical application, the environmental factors affect the performance parameters of RFID system. The most representative environmental factors are fluids and metals. In this paper, the causes of the impact of liquids and metals on the readability of RFID system are studied and RFID tag antennas resistant to metal and liquids are designed using high frequency structure simulator (HFSS). The results show that there is the absorption of radio frequency signals on the surface of liquids. Meanwhile, the reflected waves and induced eddy currents reflect the influence of metals on the antenna. Finally, the RFID antenna is modified based on the reasons that the two materials affect the antenna.

articleTitle: Indoor Pedestrian Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The aim of this paper is pedestrian detection for campus surveillance video to achieve pedestrian flow statistics. The core of this paper mainly includes two aspects: one is that corresponding to the problem of insufficient training data set, a sample fusion strategy is proposed to build a rich and highly matched training data set; the other is that according to the characteristics of experimental data based on the YOLO v3 algorithm, the model and loss function is optimized based on YOLO v3 algorithm. Experimental results on indoor pedestrian detection show that the detection accuracy is improved, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Ceramic Dielectric-Filled Cavity Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A design of ceramic dielectric-filled cavity filter is proposed, which is fabricated using an outer silver plating process. The highlight of this design is a new cross coupling method. Capacitive coupling between resonators is achieved by plating silver on the surface of the dielectric cavity. This method produces two crossing zeros in the upper and lower frequency bands of the filter to improve the out-of-band suppression. The filter consists of 10 identical quarter-wavelength resonators, and the required passband is generated by the resonance of these resonators. The coupling can be controlled by adjusting the size of the coupling window between the coaxial cavities. The depth of the tuning hole of the coaxial cavity can be adjusted, and the resonant frequencies can be independently adjusted. Finally, a filter working at 2.6 GHz is obtained. The design is validated by using the electromagnetic simulation software HFSS, which shows that the filter is suitable for the 5G base station.

articleTitle: Analysis and Test of Concrete Surface Crack of Railway Bridge Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of high-speed railway In China is large-scale and efficient. And the safety detection and monitoring of Bridges has become an important part of accounting the safety of railway operation. The characteristics of bridge surface cracks in the previous operating environment are analyzed, and YoloV3 deep learning network is used to enhance, mark and learn the crack images. The high - precision identification of bridge surface cracks is realized, Some shortcomings of this method are also analyzed and the way to upgrade in the next step is put forward.

articleTitle: A novel edge detection method based on adaptive threshold
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Edge detection is a critical component of many vision systems, including object detectors and image segmentation algorithms. Threshold setting is crucial for edge detection. Traditional threshold setting method did not use the spatial information of edge, and the detected edges are either missing or have a large number of false edges. Based on the analysis of the change trend of edge connectivity and the number of edge segment as the threshold decrease, we firstly propose an adaptive threshold setting method according to the image self-information. Then, using the adaptive threshold, the gradient map created by first order differential operator and non-max suppression is binarized into edge map. Compared with other traditional single-threshold based edge detection methods, the proposed method can detect edges that are more complete and fewer fake edges, and this method is more stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Evolution and Development of Power Generation Scale and Cost under Tradable Green Certificates Market in China
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Tradable green certificates market is an effective measure to solve the problems of high cost of renewable energy and large funding gap, single funding source and long time period of price subsidy. Economic model of tradable green certificates market is established based on system dynamics and simulation is carried out based on Vensim. Meanwhile, unit comprehensive cost of various energy under tradable green certificates market and sensitivity of key factors are analyzed deeply. The results indicate that tradable green certificates market will not only reduce subsidy funds and improve efficiency of subsidies, but also provide a new investment return mode for renewable energy, encourage investment development and effectively promote energy supply side structure optimization with reasonable renewable portfolio standard ratio and tradable green certificates validity period.

articleTitle: Practice and Application of LSTM in Temperature Prediction of HVAC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The optimization of HVAC system is an important part of building energy conservations. As a complex nonlinear system with large inertia and large lag, the traditional HVAC system adjusts temperature based on the current indoor temperature, so that the control does not involve future changes. Therefore, accurately predicting the building indoor temperature will help more stable control and provide a reference for system tuning. Air handling unit dataset, which is established by the US Department of Energy for experiments, is used in this article, and the long short-term memory (LSTM) model is also used to predict the temperature. The MAE of predictions of the final model is about 0.077 °F, and the RMSE is about 0.107 °F. The experimental results show that the LSTM can efficiently learn the trends and features of the data, and higher prediction accuracy than the traditional back propagation neural network (BP) and multi-layer perceptron (MLP).

articleTitle: Information Propagation Dynamics Model Based on Implicit Cluster Structure Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: How information is spread has always been a hot issue in the research of online social networks. Empirical research shows that the propagation process based on the original network is quite different from the real propagation process. In this paper, we design a new model to solve this problem. By combining the original network structure and individual interest attributes, our model mines the implicit cluster structure network and then predicts the propagation process of hot event based on the implicit cluster structure network. The empirical results on the Sina microblogging data set show that the simulated propagation process based on the implicit cluster structure network is outstanding in fitting the infection rate curve in the real propagation process. The results show that the potential community structure is a key factor of information dissemination mechanism.

articleTitle: A Target Tracking Method Based on Improved Camshift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of tracking frame drift and tracking failure in traditional Camshift algorithm under color interference or occlusion, an improved multi feature fusion method for Camshift target tracking is proposed. Firstly, the color feature and the HOG feature of the target are extracted respectively and fused according to a certain weight coefficient to establish the target model; secondly, the target occlusion is judged according to the similarity measurement. When the target is occluded, the target is divided into four parts, and the color feature and the HOG feature of the target are extracted respectively, and weighted fusion is carried out to establish the occluded target model; finally, a linear prediction method is proposed to replace the traditional Kalman filtering algorithm to complete the position prediction, and substitute the predicted position results into the Camshift algorithm for tracking. Experimental results show that the algorithm can improve the robustness and meet the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Network Vulnerability Scanning System Based on NVTs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the information age, computer systems have a direct effect on the safety and well-being of human beings and hence we must have lower tolerance for vulnerabilities. The vulnerability scanning technology can detect potential network security vulnerabilities, so that network administrators know in advance where the vulnerability of the network is and thus ensure the security of network system. NVT is the network vulnerability test plug-in provided by OpenVAS, which has the huge quantity and provides daily update service. The combination of multiple NVTs is used to detect vulnerability. Based on deep analysis of the current knowledge of the network-based vulnerability scanning and the usage of NVTs, this paper design a network vulnerability scanning system based on NVTs, and carries out a test of the network vulnerability scanning system, and finally presents its application prospect.

articleTitle: K-means Algorithm Description and the Application of Cluster Analysis in Heavy Truck Vehicle Fault
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper describes the k-means clustering algorithm and proposes the key problems and optimization methods used by the algorithm. The algorithm is used to analyze the fault data of heavy-truck vehicles in different driving environments, which can realize the information integration, exploratory classification and rule analysis of vehicle faults, and provide strong data support for the overall scientific evaluation and prediction of vehicles.

articleTitle: Key Technology Simulation of Equipment Anomaly Detection Based on Image Processing In Underground Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the deepening of automation of underground mining management, more and more mining area are equipped with the video monitoring system and alarm systems to realize unattended operation. Hence, it is of great practical value for the safe operation of the underground mining system to process the equipment image collected by the monitoring system, detect the equipment abnormality quickly and accurately through the monitoring image, and warn the potential danger. The related algorithms of the image processing are applied to the underground mining equipment image to analyze and study the characteristics of images when the electrical equipment is abnormal and the related detection techniques and methods. At the same time, a detection method of the mining transformer oil leakage is proposed. We first use the difference method on the sample images and monitoring images to get the abnormal region, and the noise of it will be eliminated and it will be segmented. Then the H-S color histogram of the abnormal region corresponding to the sample image and the monitoring image is extracted. The oil leakage condition is detected by observing the change of the gray-brown part of the H-S color histogram. Through experiments, we find that this method can more accurately detect the oil leakage anomalies of the transformer.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of DD Coupling Mechanism of Inductively Coupled Power Transmission System in Metal Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of metal environment on magnetic induction coupled wireless power transmission system (WPT) is studied. A DD coil coupling mechanism is proposed, and the design method of the metal surround coupling mechanism is given to improve the mutual inductance of primary and secondary sides. On this basis, the ferrite cores mechanism of DD coil was optimized to further improve the output power and efficiency of the system. Finally, an experimental platform was built to verify the effectiveness of the analysis.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnosis of Lightning Faults on Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Lightning faults are the main faults of transmission lines. Accurate and effective diagnosis of lightning fault can effectively improve the reliability of transmission lines. At present, the determination of lightning strike fault and the location of the lightning strike are determined by manually inquiring the lightning locating system after the lightning strike. In order to improve the real - time determination of lightning fault, the accuracy of lightning strike point positioning and to shorten the outage time due to the lightning strike fault, research on the automatic fault diagnosis technology of the lightning failure of transmission line. According to the lightning fault of the transmission line, the information such as the relevant information of the lightning location system, the GIS information, fault recorder data, the scheduling automation data and the multi-terminal fault location information are used to realize the accurate positioning of the tower and the automatic fault diagnosis function of the transmission line fault. The rapid detection and overhaul of lightning failure is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Solving airport taxi scheduling problem based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a method of queuing theory. It is mainly used to establish the model of taxi driver's choice and decision-making, and to analyze the influencing factors to make the model more realistic. Finally, the rationality of the model is verified by simulation, aiming to solve a series of problems faced by airport taxi more reasonably and effectively, and to promote the efficient development of airport taxi industry.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm based on Improved Similarity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm can't measure well the similarity among users under the condition of data sparsity, which leads to a decrease in the accuracy of the recommendation system. Therefore, we propose a collaborative filtering algorithm to improve similarity. We weight the number of common scoring items on the similarity calculation to improve the shortcomings of the usual Pearson correlation coefficient. Then, we use it to find the user's nearest neighbor set and predict the score of the item to generate a recommendation list. Experiments show that our algorithm can improve the accuracy of system recommendation effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-protocol Parsing in Intelligent Buildings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the intelligent building integration system includes different subsystems. Different subsystems use different communication protocols. Due to different types of intelligent devices in the same subsystem, the communication protocols used are also different, such as Modbus / TCP protocol, BACnet / IP protocol and various private protocols. Faced with the parsing of many kinds of communication protocols, if we write the parsing software for each protocol separately, the workload is large and the later maintenance is complex. Therefore, without the need to write a separate parsing program for each protocol, how to analyze multiple communication protocols is still an issue for intelligent building integration systems. Aiming at this problem, this paper combines database technology and protocol parsing technology, and uses the TCP protocol-based Socket technology to achieve mutual communication between networks. In this paper, a multi-protocol parsing and configuration system is proposed. A general-purpose protocol parsing component is designed to parse the received data packets according to the protocol data format configured in the database.

articleTitle: Suppression Strategy of Circulating Current in MMC-HVDC Based on Quasi-PR controller
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The bridge arm circulating current of modular multilevel converter (MMC) based on high-voltage direct current (HVDC) will increase because of its topological structure, which results in system loss increase and system performance degradation. For suppressing the harmonic contents of 2nd, a circulating current suppression strategy in MMC-HVDC based on quasi-PR controller is proposed, which dynamically adjusts the parameters of PR controller according to the power variation, and adopts proportional negative feedback of bridge arm current to suppress circulating current. This strategy does not require phase-to-phase decoupling and double-frequency negative sequence coordinate transformation. Only one quasi-PR controller is used for each phase to suppress bridge arm circulating current in MMC-HVDC, reducing the number of quasi-PR controllers and reducing the complexity of system design. As a result, it greatly reduces the number of use of the quasi-PR controller and the complexity of the system. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed strategy can effectively suppress the bridge arm circulating current.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Unslotted CSMA/CA Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of things in recent years, wireless sensor networks with the characteristics of short distance and low power consumption have been widely used, especially based on Unslotted CSMA/CA wireless sensor networks. How to optimize the performance of wireless sensor network in different application scenarios is a problem faced by Unslotted CSMA/CA algorithm. We use OPNET to build simulation model, and adjust two important parameters of CSMA/CA algorithm, namely BE (Backoff exponent) and NB (Number of backoff), then collect two important simulation results of network throughput and network delay. Through the analysis of the simulation results, we can find out how to adjust the parameters in different scenarios, so as to achieve the best network performance in different application scenarios of the Internet of things.

articleTitle: Road network extraction and vectorization of remote sensing images based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The road in the remote sensing image has the characteristics of slender and tortuous shape, complex connectivity, large road span, strong connectivity, complex ground information of the remote sensing image, occlusion, and different scales, etc. Based on these characteristics, this paper will do some change in Unet, included three parts: encoding, center feature extraction, decoding. The encoding part is aimed at problems that Unet can't extract rich feature for few samples. We proposes to use a pre-trained VGG model as an encoding module to improve network performance, reduce the risk of overfitting, and extract rich feature; the center feature extraction part, for the problems of occlusion, scale change, connectivity, etc., extracts the dense Dilation convolution module to maintain the resolution while expanding the receptive field to extract more distinguishing features; the decoding part In view of the different importance of features at different scales, a channel attention module is proposed to realize the fusion of high and low features. Through experimental comparison and analysis, the model has a significant effect on solving the road extraction problem of remote sensing images. Then the skeleton is extracted from the segmentation results and processed by denoising and straight line connection. The road network map is extracted from the skeleton map and vectorized to realize the automatic grid. Grid data vectorization.

articleTitle: Identity-Based Hybrid Format-Preserving Encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The format-preserving encryption has the characteristics of the encrypted data format and the same data length, and does not break the data format constraints, thereby reducing the cost of modifying the data format. The analysis of existing sensitive information format-preserving encryption schemes is based on a symmetric encryption system, which has problems such as low key transmission security and high key management cost. This paper proposes an identity-based format-preserving encryption scheme. Compared with the existing format-preserving encryption scheme, the communication parties do not need to transmit a key, and the encryption key and the decryption key are generated by the key derivation function, and the hybrid encryption is used. The way to improve the security of sensitive information transmission. It is proved that the scheme satisfies the identity-based pseudo-random permutation security, and at the same time, the scheme satisfies the adaptive selection of ciphertext indistinguishability under plaintext attack.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mechanical Deicing Method for Low Voltage Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Icing is one of the main natural disasters threatening the safety of transmission lines in cold regions, and mechanical deicing technology is one of the most important means to eliminate the adverse impact of icing. In this paper, by combing the important mechanical deicing methods at present, the characteristics and deicing requirements and the characteristics of applicable mechanical deicing schemes for low-voltage transmission lines and distribution lines is summarized are summarized. The significance of nonlinear finite element simulation technology for the design of mechanical deicing device and the optimization of deicing scheme is proposed, and the general design idea of a novel electromagnetic impact mechanical deicing device is proposed. This paper provides a useful support for accelerating the design of deicing devices for ice disaster prevention technology and improving the ability of transmission line to resist ice and snow disaster.

articleTitle: Design of an automatic impedance matching circuit based on frequency tracking of ultrasonic transducer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Ultrasound is widely used in ultrasonic detection, ultrasonography, ultrasonic oscillation, ultrasound extraction and so on. During the use of power ultrasonic transducer, the resonance frequency of the transducer tends to shift due to the changes of transducer load, aging, wear, temperature rise, fatigue and other factors. At present, there are a large number of circuit designs for automatic frequency tracking of ultrasonic transducers, but few design schemes for automatic adjustment and control of impedance matching circuit. This paper designs a circuit which can automatically adjust impedance matching based on automatic tracking of ultrasonic frequency.

articleTitle: Deep neural networks with pre-train model BERT for aspect-level sentiments classification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the amount of text on the network has shown a rapid growth trend, and the demand for text classification technology is increasing day by day, especially for aspect-level sentiments classification. However, the traditional method mainly relies on time-consuming feature engineering, but due to its context-independent nature, it ignores the rich context information in the text, which greatly reduces the performance in Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), a pre-trained language models, refreshed records on eleven NLP tasks and became a new baseline model for text classification. Although BERT has been widely used for other NLP tasks, it is rarely used on aspect-level sentiments classification. We use the BERT output containing rich contextual information as the input of the optimized DNN network, and use the DNN network for further classification to obtain better performance in aspect-level sentiment classification. We performed comparative experiments on three public datasets. Compared with other latest baseline models, our model has better performance in aspect-level sentiments classification.

articleTitle: Local information based model for epidemic controlling on multiplex networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Suppressing the outbreak of disease is one of the hottest topics that attracts large amount of related researches to devote themselves into it. In this paper we propose a resource allocation model based on the local information of each healthy nodes to study how we can allocated limited resources optimally in controlling disease spreading. To mimic the processes of resource allocation and disease spreading, we construct a two-layer multiplex network. Based on the modified Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model, we also proposed a resource based model, named rSIS. Through extensive simulations on both random multiplex network and network with edge overlapping, we find that on the random multiplex network, when the bias parameter is positive, there is worst value, at which the disease can not be controlled effectively. Besides, there is only one explosive transition at the threshold. While when the parameter is negative, resources, there is hybrid transition, and the infected density first grows continuously at the first threshold, and then jumps explosively at the second threshold. Next, we studied the case when there is edge overlapping between two layers. We find that when the parameter is positive, with the increase of infection rate, the optimal value changes dynamically. While when the parameter is negative, there is hybrid phase transitions, and resources should be allocated preferentially to the lower infectiousness nodes.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Wireless Private Network for Electric Power Company
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of the power Internet of things, wireless private network will play an important role in it. This paper first analyzes the communication requirements of existing power control, acquisition and mobile business. Then, a networking architecture of electric power wireless private network is proposed, including the overall structure, bearer network structure, backhaul network structure, core network structure, etc. At last, in order to verify the network performance, two typical electric power businesses are simulated. The results show that, electric power wireless private network can meet the communication requirements of electric power business.

articleTitle: Design of smart home controller based on raspberry PI
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to provide home intelligent control function for the elderly more efficiently and conveniently, this paper designed a smart home system controller based on raspberry PI with simple hardware structure and low development cost. The design is implemented by raspberry PI development board and python language, and the fatigue detection algorithm is implemented by OpenCV visual library, Dlib library and EAR algorithm. Through temperature and humidity sensor, infrared extended version, LCD display screen and other hardware intelligent control indoor environment. The test results show that the fatigue state can be accurately detected and the electrical control function can be realized. This design enhanced the intelligence of household control, and met the life demand of energy-saving convenience.

articleTitle: Low-frequency extension design of angular rate sensor based on magnetohydrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The poor performance of magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) angular rate sensor because of the vicious and electromagnetic force at low frequency. Which has depressed its accuracy and application range. A preliminary study on the MHD angular rate sensor model with multiple pump structures to achieve the low-frequency bandwidth expansion. Physical model of the sensor is given, and then the structural design of the MHD pump is described. The numerical simulation based on the designed models. The simulation results demonstrate that multiple MHD pump improves the uniformity of radial velocity distribution, enhance the Coriolis effect at low frequency and accelerate the relative velocity. This study provides a framework for future analysis to minimize the error.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Chemical Industry Safety Production Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Safety evaluation is to use relevant technical which evaluate the risks of the enterprise's production process. The article analyzes the shortcomings of the current chemical safety production evaluation system based on the artificial neural network knowledge. At the same time, a safety evaluation index system for chemical companies was established, and the advantages of applying neural networks in the evaluation system of chemical safety production were pointed out.

articleTitle: Spatial and Multispectral Correlations for Joint Design of Color Filter Arrays and Demosaicing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: CFA(Color filter array) is an essential component in the acquisition system, its adoption greatly decreases the acquisition size, however its design directly relates to the imaging quality. In this paper, a novel method of joint design of color filter arrays and demosaicing based on the spatial and multi-spectral correlation is proposed. The isotropic neighborhood is exploited for acquiring the spatial correlation, and the multi-spectral is utilized for the correlation cross channels. A convolutional network autoencoder is presented to design the color filter array patterns and demosaic, which comprehensively employs the spatial and multi-spectral correlation. Experiments shows that the method achieved high-quality image reconstructions, holding higher PSNR than the ones obtained by the state-the-art techniques on standard dataset.

articleTitle: A New Password Authentication Based On The Dual Model Of Apollonian Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graph coloring can solve classification problems, optimization problems and so on. In this paper, graph coloring is applied to encryption technology to encrypt the network model. In this paper, the network topology and coloring are combined, and a new network encryption coding is proposed. The security of this kind of password is based on determining that the problem of isomorphism of two graphs is NPC problem. Considering that some network model are maximal planar graph, the number of vertices and edges corresponding to its dual model is smaller than original model, we can consider encryption from the perspective of its dual model. In this paper, the dual model of Apollonian network model is selected as an example to describe the encryption algorithm, the GEMTC-chromatic number are determined, and the coloring characteristics of its minimum spanning trees and largest leaf spanning tree are studied, the relationship of GEMTC-chromatic numbers between the two kinds of spanning trees and dual models is found.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Virtual Campus Roaming System Based on OpenGL and 3Ds Max
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the technology of virtual reality, this paper discusses the design and implementation of virtual campus roaming system based on VC++ platform and OpenGL, and conducts a further research on the basic algorithm of developing virtual campus roaming system in order to provide an important campus information platform for the construction of information campus. Shanghai University of Engineering Science (Yixian Road Campus) is taken as a case to establish a campus roaming system, and the OpenGL database and 3Ds Max platform are applied as the development tools to establish a fully immersive and good realistic effect. The uer can use the mouse and keyboard and other external devices to roam in the three-dimensional virtual campus scene so that they have an immersive experience and understand this university's environmental style in a comprehensive and three-dimensional way. The experimental results show that the campus environment using this system has strong authenticity, the average running time of editing operation is 309 ms, and the user satisfaction is high.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition Model based on Adaptive Weight and Depthwise Separable Convolutions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Pedestrian attribute recognition is a technology that uses computer vision technology to determine some observable external characteristics of pedestrians in an image or video sequence, such as gender, age, clothing, and equipment, etc. It is widely used in many fields, such as intelligent security, clustering based passenger flow statistics in public places, human-computer interaction, album clustering and so on, It has high research value in the field of computer vision. Due to the complexity and diversity of pedestrian attributes, the convergence rate of each attribute is not consistent in the process of model training. Therefore, the manual training with fixed weight set by experience cannot adapt to the diversification of attributes, resulting in poor performance of the model. In recent years, in some researches, a multi-branch model is usually needed to solve this problem through multiple trainings. This method has a lot of parameter redundancy, which affects the efficiency of the model. The aim of this paper is to improve the accuracy by using a dynamic adaptive weight loss model without multiple branches in a single training. The depthwise separable convolutions is used to further improve the model recognition efficiency. After training in the PETA dataset and adding dynamic adaptive weight loss, the accuracy of the model is similar to that of some multi-branch models, and the recognition efficiency is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research and Application of J1939 Protocol in Engine Parameter Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This Combined with the practice of J1939 protocol in multi-package transmission in the development of multi-function engine intelligent monitoring system, research and application of J1939 protocol in engine parameter monitoring system is presented. Firstly, the theory of J1939 multi - packet data transmission protocol is analyzed. Secondly, the hardware and software of the system are designed. The design of the hardware circuit mainly includes the minimum system of STM32F103, the TJA1050 high-speed CAN transceiver circuit and the power supply circuit. The software part is mainly the timer configuration and transmission flow analysis of point-to-point and broadcast. Finally, with the PC, CAN analyzer, hardware circuit, online joint debugging of software and hardware. The multi-packet data transmission function of point-to-point and broadcast is realized based on J1939 protocol, and the function that the receiving node is not allowed to send information is solved. The reliability, stability and data processing accuracy of the system are verified successfully, this will promote the further development and application of J1939 protocol in agriculture production technology.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of CAN Bus and Ethernet Protocol Conversion in Heating and Energy Saving System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: CAN bus technology is used to construct the network of the bottom terminal equipment in heating and energy saving system to realize the information collection and heat flow control of the terminal room. Different heating load control strategies are provided according to different customer demands, to realize need-based heating, satisfy the personalized demands of different rooms, and avoid waste of heat energy caused by uniform heating regardless of room function. The mature Ethernet technology is used to construct the information LAN to realize the information transfer between buildings. Specialized protocol gateways are used to realize the data conversion between CAN and TCP/IP.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of standard influence based on Grey Correlation - TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Standard impact is a measure of the standard adoption relationship between standardization agencies. Based on related indicators of GB standardized database, this paper established an index system by referring to the five elements of standard influence theory proposed by Yunpeng Chen. By constructing the Grey Correlation - TOPSIS model, it comprehensively evaluated the influence of other countries and standardization organizations on GB. It is concluded that ISO, IEC, USA, Turkey and EN have great influence on GB; while Italy, Spain and Australia have less influence.

articleTitle: Research on Cataloging and Storage of Binocular Stereo Video Resources
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with the two-dimensional video, there are differences in cataloging and storage of stereo video. It is not conducive to acquisition and utilization accurately using the cataloging and storage method of two-dimensional video. In order to solve the problem of low efficiency in utilization caused by lacking of typical features and incomprehensive of file description, the cataloging and storage of binocular stereo video resources are studied. The special cataloging items of binocular stereo video resources are explored and analyzed, and the mode of storage is also explored. On this basis, a stereo vision resource management system is designed and developed, and the cataloging and storage of binocular stereo video resources are realized. The system can effectively realize the management of binocular stereo video resources, and improve the pertinence, accuracy and efficiency of acquisition and utilization.

articleTitle: The Study on the Design and Manufacture Integrated System of Complex Electric Power Product Faced to Energy Restraint
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Many existing energy management systems most only pay attention to the energy management of manufacturing process, without taking into account the reasonable design of products to reduce energy consumption. It studies the design and manufacture integrated system restrained to the energy. The overall integration solutions of the system are put forward and the key technology is studied. The structure model and data storage model of the product BOM restrained to the energy is expounded. Finally, taking the transformer manufacturing for example, the application to the manufacture integrated system of the complex electric power product and its main function modules and the software design interface are introduced. The developed system can describe the energy consumption of design, process and manufacture integration to the high pressure/ultrahigh pressure transformer, which can be generalized to design and manufacturing process of the enterprise other product and can make the enterprise save energy and reduce emission effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Adaptive Control Algorithm with Extended Dimension for Disturbance Torque
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that friction, wire-wound, wind resistance and other disturbing moments seriously affect the stability tracking precision during the task of the photoelectric pod system, the fuzzy adaptive control algorithm with extended dimension is proposed in this paper. In this method, an accelerometer is first installed on the reflector of the pod. After obtaining the linear acceleration information and transforming it into angular acceleration, the fuzzy adaptive controller is designed according to the characteristics of wind resistance pulsation torque. The controller takes the mirror angular velocity, angular acceleration and target miss distance as input, and further adjusts the output of the controller according to the change of input and the fuzzy rule base of training. This algorithm was applied to the stable tracking experiment of a certain type of pod, and the results show that the tracking accuracy is improved from 59.7μrad to 32.4 μrad. It is proved that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively suppress the disturbance torque and significantly improve the tracking accuracy and speed stability in the process of pod mission. This algorithm can be used in other servo control systems as a general method of disturbance torque suppression.

articleTitle: Light and Fast Port Scene Recognition Algorithm for Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The recognition of port scenes in remote sensing images has important application value for military, exploration, surveillance and reconnaissance. For a long time, the port area in remote sensing images is difficult to distinguish due to the complex background and large intra-class gaps, which usually requires a wide and large network for feature extraction.

articleTitle: Effective Ways to Enhance Employee Experience in Human Resource Management of Scientific Research Institutes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, most of China's scientific research institutes are affected by the talent selection mechanism, talent development and training mechanism, incentive mechanism, assessment mechanism and confidentiality requirements of scientific research tasks, and the level of human resource management is relatively low. Basically, these scientific research institutes only form centralized management of human resource data, but the degree of data sharing is generally low and the employee experience is poor. In recent years, with the diversification of the demand for talents in scientific research institutes, the human resource management of scientific research institutes must be constantly changing under the background of the times. The innovation of scientific research and management mechanism has become the trend of the scientific research institutes, and enhancing employee experience is one of the urgent tasks of the scientific research institutes. Based on the current situation of human resource management in these research institutes, this paper proposes the effective ways to enhance employee experience in human resource management from four perspectives, so as to lay a foundation for the overall realization of human resource strategic transformation.

articleTitle: A Short-Term Forecasting Approach for Regional Electricity Power Consumption by Considering Its Co-movement with Economic Indices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electricity power consumption of a certain city or even a region always has a close relationship with the economic development of the corresponding area. Thus, interpreting the characteristics of previous regional electricity power consumption data as well as past economic data, and finding out the interrelation between them, would be of great reference value in doing the short-term forecasting work together for both. The combined forecasting work will undoubtedly be more rational and accurate in giving future electricity power consumption tendency, by comparing with the work merely based on electricity power consumption data itself. Till now, most related research have focused on analyzing the mutual relationship between electricity power consumption and economic development, forecasting work based on both aspects can still hardly be found. In this paper, a short-term forecasting approach for regional electricity power consumption by considering its co-movement with economic indices has been proposed, it has fully considered the interaction between electricity power consumption and the economic indices, and has let the forecasting result of latter make the “secondary correction” to the result of former. By setting a certain region in central western China as an example, the effectiveness of proposed approach has been proved.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Squirrel Cage Five-phase Motor lost one Phase
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Five-phase induction motor contains abundant magnetomotive force harmonics due to the similar number of poles and slots, which will affect the torque performance of the motor. So in this paper, the magnetic potential of squirrel-cage five-phase induction motor is taken as the main research object, and the electromagnetic field theory is adopted, the resultant magnetic potential and stability of five-phase induction motor operating without one phase are analyzed by calculating the electromotive force of each phase, and then the analysis is tested to verify the correctness of the conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on Configuration and Coordinated Control of DFACTS in Flexible Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Flexible distribution network, which can provide reliable and economical power supply to customers based on customized power technology, is becoming a new choice to sensitive user groups. DFACTS equipments are important parts of flexible distribution network. In this paper, structure, working principle, characteristics, model of typical DFACTS equipments are introduced. Then, interaction mechanism between DFACTS based on Relative Gain Array(RGA) is analyzed. Finally, configuration and coordinated control strategy among multiple DFACTS devices in flexible distribution network are proposed. Positive references for analyzing, control and application of DFACTS are provided in this paper.

articleTitle: PPTL model checking for blockchains
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: How to model and verify the actions with true concurrency in a blockchain? This is an open issue. To this end, Propositional Projection Temporal Logic (PPTL) is employed to model a blockchain. And then, the existing PPTL model checking algorithm is employed to check some temporal properties in the blockchain. As a result, a new method for modeling and verification of blockchains is formed. Compared with the existing approaches, the new one has ability of deal with true concurrency (synchronization mechanism) in a blockchain, in the process of formal verification.

articleTitle: Parallel Computation Of Deep Neural Network Optimized Based On ML-Metis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, accelerated computation of deep neural networks(DNN) has become a hot topic. Using Metis, a graph partitioning algorithm, to divide the DNN data flow graph, and then perform model parallelization on DNN is a common method to improve the speed of its calculation. However, because Metis cannot capture all the characteristics of a data flow graph, it is often inefficient. This paper proposes an improved graph partitioning algorithm, ML-Metis, which can take into account the memory reuse and intermediate data of the data flow graph during partitioning, and provide an efficient parallel strategy for DNN.

articleTitle: Operator Training Evaluation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is necessary to evaluate operation level of drivers while training them through a driving simulator. In order to avoid the one-sidedness of evaluation only based on vehicle driving conditions or operating logic, a deep learning method is proposed to train the LSTM network using driving data and manual evaluation results to obtain an intelligent evaluation system. In order to generate sample data for training, an expert system based on production rules is constructed. By training the neural network, the evaluation method is more flexible and adaptable than traditional expert systems, which can intelligently evaluate the driver's operation quality.

articleTitle: An Iterative Algorithm of Linear Least Squares to Identify Online the Capacity of Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is known that supercapacitors exhibits a voltage-dependent capacitance and the capacitance varies approximately linearly with voltage in the normal operation voltage range. To solve the online supercapacitor capacity identification problem, which is an important function to implement in supercapacitor management system, firstly, linear least squares (LLS) is applied to get a closed-form solution based on a sequence of sampling terminal voltage and charging current data, and in the meanwhile, the details of voltage data processing to obtain more accurate differential capacitance values are elaborated. Secondly, to overcome the difficulty that the closed-form solution involves large data set, takes calculation of matrix inverse, and hence leads to heavy computing burden, an iterative algorithm of LLS is deduced, which gets rid of calculating matrix inverse directly, decomposes the computing burden of LLS into each sampling period, and therefore makes itself more applicable in online identification situations. Lastly, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Shock Resistance Design and Simulation Test Method of an Antenna Base
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper takes the antenna base of a certain equipment as the research object. According to the engineering practice, the research method of “design- simulation - optimization - test and verification” is adopted to evaluate the impact resistance of the antenna base, the impact resistance of the antenna base is evaluated objectively through the test. The double-wave Impact machine were used to test and evaluate the impact resistance of the antenna base, which provided a reference for similar devices containing a large number of electronic components to carry out impact resistance design, dynamic analysis and impact test. It provides a more scientific method to ensure that electronic equipment can meet the requirements of shock resistance design and lightweight design.

articleTitle: A General Web Page Extraction Method Aiming at Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Recently, online social networks such as Twitter and Facebook have become one of the most important information communication platforms, which contain large number of useful user data for various research fields. Extracting information from online social network pages is the fundamental key technique of online social network study. In this paper, we have proposed a general web page extraction method according to the structural feature of online social network web pages. Based on our method we can select useful information in web page with class tag frequency and after some simple string manipulation processes the exact content will be achieved. Furthermore, we have proposed an automatic particular regular expression generation algorithm which can make our content extraction method apply to many similar structure online social networks without re-writing the entire extraction process facing to each web site. The experimental results show that our approach has good adaptability and shows significant advantages in both precision and recall.

articleTitle: Construction of Safety Psychological Model for Power Distribution Operational Maintenance Posts of Power Grid Enterprises Based on Fully Connected Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In power grid enterprises, a series of unsafe behaviors, such as violation of labor discipline, operating rules and methods, are easy to cause power safety accidents. Therefore, it is particularly important to predict the risks of unsafe behaviors of employees. Firstly, this paper uses the methods of literature review and questionnaire survey to explore the psychological factors related to the safety behavior of employees in specific positions in power grid enterprises, and obtains five indicators: personality quality, cognitive ability, work values, mental health and social environment. Then the method of fully connected neural network is adopted to finally obtain the safety psychological model. The average absolute value loss of this model is 0.049512, which can predict unsafe behaviors of employees well in specific positions.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of a Novel Parallel Moving Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A novel 3 degree of freedom (DOF) parallel moving platform that can produce 1-DOF translations and 2-DOF rotation was proposed. First, the mechanism description and motion form of the mechanism are expounded, the DOF and the motion feature of the mechanism is verified by the constraint screw method. Then from the input and output equation of the mechanism, the Jacobi matrix characteristic of the mechanism is analyzed according to the different layout plan, and the driving and installation mode under full isotropic condition is obtained. the Jacobi matrix of the mechanism is analyzed and the arrangement scheme of the mechanism is obtained. Finally, the kinematics analysis of the mechanism is carried out and the kinematics and geometry relation of the mechanism is obtained. The workspace of the mechanism is simulation analyzed and a set of data is verified and analyzed, which lays a theoretical foundation for further application of the mechanism.

articleTitle: Schedulability of Strictly Periodic Tasks with Communication Dependence
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Non-preemptive tasks with strict periods are usually adopted in practical multi-core real-time systems when continual sampling and processing of data are required. Systems designers need to provide a proper scheduling strategy such that the tasks deadlines will be met even under the worst-case conditions. In this paper, we study the scheduling problem of non-preemptive tasks with strict periods in multi-core real-time systems. First, we analyze the characteristics of the multi-core real-time system, build a task model with strict periodic constraints, analyze the requirements of space resources, time resources and communication delay when the system can be scheduled, and propose a solution to determine the task schedulability based on mixed integer linear programming. The practical results show that the proposed solution can not only be used to determine the schedulability of multi-core real-time system, but also to obtain the minimum number of processors needed by the system, which can guide the design of the system.

articleTitle: Design and Airgap Optimization of a Doubly Salient Permanent Magnet Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Doubly salient permanent magnet machine (DSPM) is a kind of machine that appeared after the emergence of switched reluctance machine. It is a mechatronic system that combines the structure of switched reluctance machine and permanent magnet material. DSPMs have the advantages of simple structure, good speed regulation performance, fast dynamic response, high power factor, high efficiency, etc., and can achieve various special requirements of torque / speed characteristics. This paper uses the existing design experience to design the basic dimensions of a 300 W machine and optimize the design. The finite element analysis results show that the magnetic field distribution in the machine is ideal, the EMF waveform is in line with expectations, and the design scheme is reasonable.

articleTitle: Pilot's Pitch Control Analysis based on Wavelet Decomposition and Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Induced by pilot's incorrect pitch manipulation, unstabilized approach is one of the most essential safety issues remaining to be addressed. Pitch control quality of flight crew is studied in this paper by analyzing the angle variation characteristics of control column in cockpit. Manipulation data of control column was analyzed by wavelet decomposition rather than processing in time domain. In addition, the obtained parameter set of wavelet energy and wavelet energy entropy were further fed into a K-means clustering algorithm. As a result, 227 groups of control column position data are divided into five levels to detect abnormal pitch operation. The results show that the above algorithm gives an innovative way to judge the stability of pilot's manipulation during approach.

articleTitle: Input-output Sector Evaluation from the Perspective of Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The input-output table reflects the interaction and dependence between industrial sectors, and the flow of products reflects the influence of each sector in the national economy. In this paper, the weighted PageRank algorithm in the field of complex networks is used to rank the importance of each sector in the input-output table of China's 42 × 42 in 2017. The sorting results are explained based on the principle of the algorithm, which shows the effectiveness of the algorithm in identifying key departments. Among them, due to the attention and investment of the state, the three sectors including Architecture, Public management and social security, and Transportation equipment, have shown significant advantages, so they have achieved a higher position than other sectors.

articleTitle: Influence of Large-scale Synchronous Condenser on Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of insufficient dynamic reactive power compensation and small short-circuit capacity of ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system, it is a practical and effective scheme to install a certain number of synchronous condensers (SCs) at the receiving end of UHVDC. However, the connected SCs will provide a lot of sub-transient and transient currents in the case of AC system fault, which may affect the operation of AC protection. This paper takes distance and current differential protections of high-voltage transmission network as examples to analyze the influence of the large-scale SC on relay protection. Firstly, the system modeling is carried out. Secondly, the influences of SC's output current on the measuring resistance and differential current are analyzed. Finally, in PSCAD, the electromagnetic transient simulation model of the AC power grid including the SC and its excitation control system is established, and the theory analysis results is verified by simulation. The research shows that the branch coefficient of the adjacent lines will be increased with the connection of the SC, which will increase the measurement impedance, reduce the sensitivity of the distance protection and even cause the protection's refusing action. The connection of the SC will increase the differential current slightly, and the differential protection can still operate reliably.

articleTitle: A Fast and High-Precision Correction Method of Time Uniform System Deviation Based on Double Quadratic Polynomial Fittings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When the measurement and control equipment is evaluated for accuracy in the outer field, it is necessary to track and measure the target flying along the precise route. When we compare standard coordinate data with measured coordinate data, the time of the two data needs to be precisely aligned first. Based on the analysis of the straight-line path tracking parameters with the minimum radial range point [1], and based on quadratic polynomial fitting, afast and high-precision correction method of time uniform system deviationis designed based on double quadratic polynomial fittings. Simulation and comparison of the calculation time and accuracy of the one-time fitting method show that the method can provide strong support for rapid correction of time series deviations.

articleTitle: The correlation analysis of the multi-source and heterogeneous data based on drilling information of the layered formation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to effectively identify the geological information of the layered formation, the drilling information obtained from the independent drilling test-bed was analyzed and aligned through the information fusion technology, and the heterogeneous data was constructed. The corresponding relationship between the drilling information of the drilling rigs and the layered formation characteristics was established by using data mining method, and the combination of the sensitive drilling parameters was screened. The relationship between various drilling parameters was analyzed by principal component analysis, and the output analysis model of the typical layered formation characteristics was established. The characteristic roots and eigenvectors of each principal component were calculated. The appropriate principal component was selected according to the cumulative contribution rate greater than 90%. The original drilling parameter information could be analyzed by calculating the comprehensive score. The results show that the optimization method is reasonable and feasible, which lays a foundation for the real-time and accurate identification of the characteristics of the coal and rock while drilling.

articleTitle: A Fast SNR-based Vibration Events Detection Algorithm for AETA Geo-acoustic Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Abundant information can be mined from AETA geo-acoustic data. In this paper, a fast SNR-based vibration events detection algorithm is proposed by improving traditional STA/LTA algorithm for these data. Background noise sampling and different update strategies during different states are applied to improve detection performance. Furthermore, we studied relative method to update the eigenvalues in O(1) time when an element in the sliding window is operated so data stream can be detected in O(N) time. Finally, in the experience part, white Gaussian noise with SNR range from 3 to 10dB is added to the geo-acoustic data of 72 AETA stations around the Longmenshan fault zone from October to November 2019 and result is measured by start point relative error, end point relative error and detected energy ratio. Result shows that the proposed method achieves considerable detection effect for vibration events in AETA geo-acoustic data with low computation complexity.

articleTitle: Methods for Extracting Dispersion Curve of Scholte Wave in the Bottom of Shallow Water
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to evaluate the performances of different methods for extracting dispersion curves of Scholte waves in the bottom of shallow water, the dispersion curves of phase velocity and group velocity of Scholte wave are extracted by F-K transformation, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\tau-p$</tex> transformation and moving window analysis method respectively, in which the seismic wave data in the shallow water simulated by high-order staggered grid finite difference method, then results are compared with the theoretical values. Performances of three methods are evaluated by parameters of relative error, mean square error and correlation coefficient. The results show that among the above three methods, the phase velocity and group velocity dispersion curves given by F-K transformation have the best correlation with the theoretical values, and those given by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\tau-p$</tex> transformation with the highest accuracy. Moving window analysis can only extract the group velocity dispersion curve, and its computational accuracy is between that of others.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dynamic Programming Based Tracking Control for Switched Unmanned Underwater Vehicle Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this work, adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) is introduced to solve the tracking control problems of unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV). Two unmanned underwater vehicle model are considered. One is without model uncertainties and the other is with model uncertainties. The switched error tracking systems is constructed based on the desired model. The ADP controller is constructed by a single critic neural network. The simulation results show that the overall systems achieve better tracking performance.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Employee Flow Based on Semi-Markov Chain and its Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The core of human resources management is to manage and regulate the flow process of the whole process of employees' training and promotion. Scientific and reasonable staff turnover forecast is the key to achieve efficient and accurate human resource management. Based on the semi-Markov chain, this paper constructs the flow model of employees among turnover, promotion, training, salary increase and so on. Based on the above mobility model, a human resource management-oriented team structure monitoring and optimization system is designed to provide enterprise managers with the ability of workforce structure monitoring and planning adjustment.

articleTitle: Optimized Implementation of K_means Clustering Algorithm on Reconfigurable System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Clustering analysis has a very broad application prospects for all walks of life in the era of big data and cloud computing, and there are increasingly high requirements for the optimization and implementation of clustering algorithm. In this paper, we implement a K-means optimization algorithm of clustering algorithm under the background of reconfigurable system application, and provide an effective hardware acceleration solution for machine learning algorithm of large data.

articleTitle: Analysis of radar angle measurement error caused by active fluctuation of multiple scattering points
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper analysis the radar angle measurement error caused by active fluctuation of different scattering points. By using artificial electromagnetic surface metamaterials such as Frequency Selective Surface (AFSS), we can easily achieve our goals to modulate the RCS of the target. The real target is own to multiple factors such as target distance, flight attitude, and so on, which will cause the difference of measurement data. The analysis of materials is becoming more and more popular, and scholars usually focus on how to increase or decrease the RCS of materials. However, there is little study on establishing linkages between materials and angle measurement. This paper mainly study the linkages between the modulate of materials and the radar angle measurement. and the optimal protection model is given by different control methods of scattering points. Finally, the simulation results show that the model can increase the radar angle measurement error and improve the target protection ability within the allowable range of materials.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Traffic Scheduling Mechanism for Multi-homed Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is popular for a campus network to connect more than one ISP link. To schedule the egress traffic in this multi-homed network, traditional scheduling schemes consider the network topology while ignoring the diversity of network services, which easily leads to link congestion and poor scheduling effect. Motivated by that, the paper proposes a collaborative traffic scheduling mechanism (CTSM) based on network traffic identification and classification. CTSM will analyze and identify the egress traffic of the multi-homed network, and then the specific application traffic is scheduled to the link that conforms to its traffic feature. Application traffics which are sensitive to time-delay will be scheduled to the links with low delay and packet loss rate, and traffics which require a lot of bandwidth will be scheduled to the links with low load. The experiments and evaluations show that CTSM makes multi-link load more balanced and the scheduling effect more reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Statistical Survey Methods of Chinese Export Enterprises - Take Guangdong export enterprises as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article starts with the analysis that Chinese export enterprises are affected by technical and trade measures, and concludes that in order to reduce the losses of Chinese export enterprises in foreign trade transactions, it is necessary to conduct a sample survey of the enterprises. Secondly, the importance of sampling survey leads to the traditional sampling method and the application of traditional sampling method in current enterprise sampling. Thirdly, starting from the purpose of this study and the multiple attributes of enterprises, the limitations of traditional methods in this study are introduced, and a sampling improvement method based on kohonen clustering results is derived. Finally, taking Guangdong export company data as an example, the improved sampling method was applied in practice and quantitative analysis was performed in the form of accurate data. It was concluded that kohonen stratified sampling is more applicable to the impact of technology trade measures on Chinese export enterprises than traditional sampling. Research.

articleTitle: Research on Model Based Digital Definition of Complex Product
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problems in the process of complex product design, such as complex structure, high manufacturing requirements for key parts, complex and scattered design information, and difficulties to ensure information consistency etc., a product design and manufacturing mode in a full three-dimensional environment is proposed. The product information is precisely defined by MBD technology, based on the establishment of digital spatial model, the content of MBD dataset and the information expression method of multi view are determined, making 3D model the only data source in the whole life cycle of product development. At the same time, the product and design process knowledge model and its associated model based on semantic network are constructed, which can better apply design knowledge to the process of product digital definition, realize the sharing and reuse of the knowledge, and improve the efficiency of product research and development.

articleTitle: Research on Adjustable Energy Consumption Braking System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Energy consumption braking is widely used in the field of air winch. When the BLDCM (Brushless Direct Current Motor) is in the reverse braking state, the energy-consuming braking circuit reduces the bleeder power of the bleeder resistor and the volume of the energy-saving brake bleeder resistor by adjusting the duty cycle of the switching tube.
