In this paper, the Matlab simulation model is used to verify that reducing the duty cycle can reduce the heating power of the bleeder resistor to reduce the volume of the bleeder resistor, thereby increasing the controller power density.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation Analysis on Vertical Nulls of DVOR in Electromagnetic Environment Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: DVOR is an important part of civil aviation navigation. Different heights and sizes of counterpoise will affect the DVOR's radiation field pattern, which will generate the vertical nulls of the signal at certain angles, resulting in the aircraft not receiving navigation signals at certain flight levels. Based on the principle of DVOR antenna and the principle of signal propagation, this paper simulates and analyzes DVOR antennas with different heights and sizes of counterpoise, verifies the agreement between the theoretical and actual vertical nulls positions, and the flight measurement was performed on an actual DVOR station. The measurement results show that the theoretically calculated vertical nulls has a high consistency with the actual measured vertical nulls.

articleTitle: Mining of Autism Intervention Methods based on PyLtp Package and TextRank Graph Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This Scrapy framework has been used to extract autistic posts from Baidu Tieba as experimental data, using the API of the application program interface provided by the language technology platform (LTP) provided by Harbin Institute of Technology, to perform Chinese Word Segmentation, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, dependency parsing, event triplet construction and relation extraction on experimental data. The TextRank graph algorithm is used to extract the keywords, and the key words, high frequency words and event network of the corpus are visualized in the form of graph. The results show that “Tomatis Training” is an effective way to improve hearing and attention in children with autism.

articleTitle: Research and application of distribution line information model and automatic mapping display technology based on SVG
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the existing distribution line information storage is not unified, the formation of the diagram is not clear, the protection configuration chaos and so on. This paper presents a standard information model based on the electric quantity of distribution lines. Based on this model, an automatic mapping and display method of distribution lines is proposed. On this basis, a set of auxiliary decision-making software for hierarchical protection configuration of distribution lines is developed based on scalable vector graphics (SVG) software mapping technology. The automatic optimization of distribution line protection configuration is realized. The effectiveness and practicability of the technology are verified by the software operation, manual calculation and field application.

articleTitle: Assessment Model for Perceived Visual Complexity of GIS System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Although the visual complexity of GIS interface information display has increased in recent years, few researchers have examined the impact of this visual complexity. Based on the characteristics of the GIS system, we divide the interface into window information areas and map areas for research. The complexity of the window is divided into the number, type, and relationship corresponding to the number of colors and characters, the presence or absence of word map combinations, and the presence or absence of visual partitions. Map complexity focuses on the complexity of the target stimulus and combines it with semantic complexity to explore the visually complex evaluation model of the entire interface. The experimental results confirm the rationality of interface complexity partitioning and provide a reference for the study of more complex human-computer interaction systems.

articleTitle: Kernelized Correlation Filter with Scale Estimation and Feedback Mechanism for Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The previous target tracking algorithms based on correlation filters have excellent tracking performance. However, when encountering some challenging problems such as fast motion, occlusion, scale variations, motion blur, etc., tracking drift or even tracking failure occurs during the tracking process. Aiming at the above problems, we propose a novel tracking method. On the basis of kernelized correlation filter, a scale adaptive filter is added to adapt to the scale variations of the target during the tracking process. In addition, a feedback mechanism using the average peak-to-correlation energy (APCE) as the judgment criterion is introduced to enable the model to be updated under the premise of high-confidence and avoid tracking model corruption. Experimental results show that our algorithm performs better than traditional correlation filtering algorithms on challenging sequences.

articleTitle: Off-axis aberration correction of liquid mirror telescope based on magnetic fluid deformable mirror and a spherical mirror
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Liquid Mirror Telescope (LMT) has become a viable alternative to traditional telescopes in astronomical exploration and other fields. Due to liquid property limitations, LMT cannot be tilted as the traditional telescopes when it observes the sky. In order to expand the observation field of LMT, the off-axis aberration must be compensated. In this paper, an adaptive optics system having a spherical mirror and a magnetic fluid deformable mirror (MFDM) is designed to compensate the large aberrations of a 3-m f/4 LMT observing at an off-axis angle of 10 degrees from the zenith. The spherical mirror is used to correct the lower order aberrations and is placed at a certain distance away from the LMT optical axis. MFDM is a new type of wavefront corrector which is used to correct the residual aberrations of the corrected off-axis aberration. The designed MFDM has a radius of 100 mm with 1141 magnetic coils as the actuator. A Maxwell coil is placed on the periphery of the MFDM to generate a large uniform magnetic field so that the response of actuators can be driven linearly. The off-axis aberration of the LMT is simulated in ZEMAX and the correction ability of the spherical mirror and MFDM is simulated in COMSOL and MATLAB. All simulation results demonstrate that the MFDM combine with a spherical mirror can effectively correct the off-axis aberration of the LMT.

articleTitle: Research on Attitude Control System of Four-Rotor UAV Based on Two Ring Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, based on the dynamics model of four-rotor UAV, a double closed-loop controller is designed by using PID algorithm, with the outer loop as position loop and the inner loop as attitude loop. The stability of the control system is simulated and verified in MATLAB. The simulation results show that the double closed-loop controller designed in this paper can ensure the stable flight of the aircraft and has certain anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Study on Posture Transformation Control of a Deformable Robot between Two-foot and Four-foot
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A posture transformation control strategy between two-foot and four-foot of a deformable robot is proposed. The robot can be transformed into a two-foot walking mode or a four-foot walking mode as needed which makes it has the advantages and functions of both a biped robot and a quadruped robot. Because of uncertain factors during the modeling process, the sliding mode variable structure control is used to determine the rotation speed of the robot body. The robustness and load capacity of the system are all improved, and the robot can always keep balanced during the posture transformation process.

articleTitle: Human pose estimation with spatial context relationships based on graph convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the statistical verification that there is a monotonic relationship between the probability of correctly estimating human joints and their confidence values, this paper proposed a human pose estimation model with spatial context relationships based on graph convolution. The model firstly selects credible joints according to the confidence threshold, and then uses human joints as nodes and the spatial context relationships between the joints as edges to construct a human pose graph, and achieves the spatial inference of credible joints to incredible joints by graph convolution. The model can be embedded in any existing pose estimator to achieve end-to-end training. And the experimental results on the MPII dataset show that the model can realize the propagation of position information between joints, and the spatial context relationships between joints are beneficial to correct the location of incredible joints.

articleTitle: The Proposed Simplified Iterative Decoding for 2D-ISI Magnetic Recording Channels
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 2D inter-symbol-interference (2D-ISI) channel models ultra-high-density magnetic recording systems, which suffer from ISI in the down track direction and inter-tack interference along the cross-track direction. These interferences seriously degrade the performance of the magnetic recording systems. Low-density parity check (LDPC) codes was used in storage systems However, although non-binary LDPC codes with log-BP decoding was designed for 2D-ISI channels, it has a drawback of a high decoding complexity. To address this issue, this paper proposes a simplified iterative decoding for 2D-ISI channels. In specific, we use extended min-sum (EMS) decoding with truncation of messages to simplify computation and optimize scale factor in outer iteration by the EXIT analysis to improve the performance. Finally, the simulated results show that the proposed scheme with reduced complexity for 2D-ISI system can maintain an approximate performance to traditional one. Even at high SNR regions, the proposed scheme will be better than previously decoding algorithm.

articleTitle: Active Control of Pantograph Based on Prior-information of Catenary
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the external disturbance and model uncertainty of high-speed railway pantograph system, a neural network-sliding mode active control strategy of pantograph based on catenary prior information was proposed. Taking advantage of the good self-adaptation of sliding mode control to the perturbation and interference of system and the characteristic of neural network approximation to the uncertain nonlinear function, a neural network-sliding mode pantograph active controller was designed. The ideal vertical displacement of the pantograph head is determined according to the periodic distribution of the contact wire and the speed of the train. The uncertain part of the model is approximated by training and learning the pantograph head displacement error and the error change rate to reduce the influence of the uncertain part to the pantograph head displacement. The stability and convergence of the system are guaranteed by adaptive weight adjustment. The control effect of controller on model uncertainty and stiffness change is analyzed through simulation, which validates that the pantograph neural network sliding mode variable structure active control based on catenary prior information proposed in this paper has strong anti-interference to parameter perturbation and make pantograph head displacement and contact wire displacement have better matching characteristic.

Author Keywords: neural network-sliding mode variable structure control

articleTitle: A TDC-Based Design Method for Multi-sub-band Joint Modulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional multi-band Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system realizes ultra-wide-band (UWB) communication by means of sub-band aggregation. For the weak anti-detection/anti-interception ability of multi-band OFDM communication system, a design method for multi-sub-band joint modulation waveform based on transform domain communication (TDC) is proposed in this paper. As signal anti-detection characteristics can be effectively improved by virtue of primary function noise and spread-spectrum characteristics of TDC, a joint modulation method of multiple strongly correlated sub-bands is designed so that modulation information is distributed in multiple sub-bands. When a sub-band is detected, anti-interception performance of the system will be improved.

articleTitle: Design of the state simulation for the primary equipment of smart substation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the vigorous advancement of smart grid construction, the pace of smart substation construction is accelerating. This design is based on the transformation of more and more common intelligent substations, which was conceived in order to speed up the commissioning of a field equipment. This device truly simulates the status of the primary equipment, including the circuit breaker, disconnector and grounding switch, receives remote control commands from the measurement, control and protection devices. When the primary equipment does not have a transmission, it performs the test of the entire group of relay protection, monitoring system remote signal remote control, lockout logic, and program control. The related work can make the site installation and commissioning not subject to civil engineering, electrical primary and electrical secondary installation. Speed up the progress of secondary debugging, reduce costs and the impact caused by debugging.

articleTitle: Correlation Power Analysis for SM4 Based on ISOMAP
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In Correlation Power Analysis (CPA), the problem is that the attacking rate becomes slow when there are many power sampling points. We introduced a method of preprocessing power data based on ISOMAP. Before performing CPA, this method uses the ISOMAP algorithm to reduce the dimension of power matrix. Under the guarantee of the intrinsic dimension of the power consumption matrix, the computational complexity of the CPA is reduced. At the same time, after the dimension is reduced, the data correlation is enhanced, which improves the attack efficiency of CPA.

articleTitle: The Reverse Design and NC Machining of Industrial Products Based on Reverse Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is an important development direction of machining industry in the future to obtain the data parameters of existing industrial products quickly, so as to realize the secondary development and improvement as well as shorten the research and development cycle of products effectively. This paper introduces the reverse design based on reverse engineering and the realization process of NC machining technology by taking the secondary development of safety hammer for vehicle as an example.

articleTitle: POLSAR Image Classification Based on SVM and WD-MRF Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Terrain classification is an important application of SAR data interpretation. The orientation between radar and the ground objects has great impact on the discrimination of polarimetric feature. Besides, the existed methods can not make sure that the pixels at the edge of a category are classified correctly as well as that pixels at a region of the same category are consistent. To solve these problems, a new supervised classification method based on Markov random filed model using Wishart distance (WD-MRF) for SAR image classification is proposed, which combines polarimetric feature with image spatial information. First, the feature space is constructed by polarimetric feature in the rotation domain and the texture feature obtained from the gray-level co-occurrence matrix. Then the initial result obtained from support vector machine is optimized with the proposed WD-MRF method. Experiments with the benchmark data sets of Flevoland show that the overall classification accuracy of WD-MRF is much higher than support vector machine.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Allocation and Economic Evaluation for Improving PV Short-term Forecast Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic(PV) short-term forecast accuracy is not high and it is difficult to meet the scheduling requirements. Energy storage devices can improve the PV forecast accuracy, but there is a contradiction among improving forecast accuracy, energy storage capacity allocation and economics. In this paper, the probability density estimation method is used to analyze the distribution characteristics of PV prediction errors. A calculation model for energy storage allocation is established taking into account the relationship between economy, prediction accuracy and capacity. An optimal control strategy for energy storage charge and discharge with a better tracking prediction value is constructed by using the principle of “replenishment of the shortage”. The tracking-economic factor is introduced to obtain the economic evaluation method of energy storage device. The simulation analysis shows that the PV prediction error has a normal distribution characteristic, and the established control strategy is effective and practicable. The method proposed prevents the energy storage device from being fast and complete Charging and discharging process while improving the accuracy of PV short-term output prediction. Therefore, the economic utilization level of the energy storage device is improved.

articleTitle: Research of Real-Time Deterministic Ethernet in Launch Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The demands of mass data transmission, intelligent test and fast launching technology requires the backbone communication network of the launch vehicle to be scalable and flexible. By improving the link layer and application layer protocols in the commercial Ethernet transmission process, a real-time deterministic network based on high-precision clock synchronization is proposed to meet the working requirements of the on-board control system and telemetry system. The simulation results verify the correctness and feasibility of the real-time deterministic Ethernet for spacecraft. The method provides support for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Design of Attitude Control Law for Over-Shoulder Launch of Helicopter-borne Air-to-ground Missile
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to realize the agile turn for over-shoulder launch of helicopter air-to-ground missile, a design method of attitude controller based on sliding mode approach law is proposed. The motion equation of missile is established by the quaternion method. Then the small disturbance linear state space model is adopted to design control system. Through the linear distribution strategy of the air / gas-rudder composite actuator, a simplified control system design model is obtained. The attitude controller is designed based on the sliding mode approach law theory, and the disturbance compensation is adopted to ensure the stability of the system. The simulation results show that the motion equation based on quaternion is effective, and the attitude control system can effectively track the pitch attitude command and meet the performance requirements.

articleTitle: A new vertex-distinguishing edge coloring algorithm based on objective function
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A new algorithm for vertex-distinguishing edge coloring of graph is designed. First of all, by definition of vertex-distinguishing edge coloring, we know that there exist two constraints rules, one is the edge constraint and the other is the vertex color set constraint. Second, we established objective function according to the two constraint rules. Third, based on the exchange rules, an algorithm is designed to make the objective function meet the requirements. The algorithm steps are described in detail. The experimental results show that the vertex-distinguishing edge coloring obtained by the algorithm conforms to the coloring conditions. This algorithm can effectively solve this coloring problem of graphs with large number of vertices.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for obtaining the vertex distinguishing edge coloring of graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: We design a new algorithm, based on the graph generation method, to solve the problem of vertex distinguishing edge coloring of some kinds of special graphs. Our main contributions to solving this graph coloring problem are: firstly, we generate the adjacent matrices of graphs; secondly, we input these matrices to our proposed algorithm; thirdly, the algorithm will output the corresponding vertex distinguishing edge colored matrices; fourthly, through analyzing of the results obtained by our algorithm, we conclude that regular chromatic number are found in some of the graphs involved. We think that our proposed algorithm is innovative and can be adopted by other researchers.

articleTitle: Research on Parasitic Parameter Variation Law of Fully-immersed Liquid Cooling IGBT Module
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing power density of IGBT module, the problem of reliability reduction caused by overheating has attracted more and more attention. It is an effective way to improve the reliability of IGBT module by using the fully-immersed liquid cooling technology. At the same time, the influence of the medium environment of the fully-immersed liquid cooling technology on the parasitic parameters of the IGBT module needs to be studied. In this paper, parasitic inductances and resistances of the IGBT module under air cooling and fully-immersed liquid cooling are extracted by simulation, and parasitic capacitances of the IGBT module under air cooling and fully-immersed liquid cooling are extracted by experiment respectively. The variation law of parasitic parameters of IGBT module under fully-immersed liquid cooling is obtained. The research results lay a foundation for the successful application of fully-immersed liquid cooling technology in the field of IGBT cooling.

articleTitle: Study on Insulation Properties of UHVDC Dry Bushing Core Material
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The UHVDC dry bushing is widely used in the GIS equipment, which is important part of electrical isolation between the central conductor and the grounding flange. The macroscopic dielectric and the thermal conductivity of the body material of the pot insulator are related to its micro-structure, and the electrical performance parameters of the pot determine its global electric field distribution under condition of current and voltage, and distribution of the electric field also provides the basis for the structural design and optimization of the bushing condenser. In this paper, the insulation performance of the material used in the dry bushing is analyzed. The heating curve of the dry bushing was obtained by using the theoretical model. The relationship between the hot-spot temperature and the current load was calculated. Research shows: the insulating properties of the bushing material have significant nonlinear relationship with the temperature. The eddy current field and harmonic field analysis method by finite element method (FEM) can effectively calculate the heat of the center conductor and the bushing condenser under 50Hz condition.

articleTitle: Study on the Preparation and Application of Vector Reference Map
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In scene matching, we use vector data instead of raster data to prepare a reference map. The BSP -algorithm is used to manage the vector data and then it is loaded on the aircraft. During the guidance process, reference maps are real-time prepared based on the track information and camera parameters. As the vector reference map is very different from the real-time map, conditional generation adversarial networks are used to convert the real-time map to a vector-style image and then match it to the vector reference map, which can achieve 86% matching accuracy.

articleTitle: MP2P Resource Node Selection Strategy based on Reputation and Bayesian Game
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The MP2P (mobile peer-to-peer) topology is limited by wireless bandwidth, battery energy, the unreliable and the move node, this paper proposes a selection strategy to improve safety and assets node which based on Reputation and Bayesian Game in MP2P network. The proposed method is including two steps. First, using the dynamic BGT (Bayesian Game Theory) to gain the reputation of resource node. Secondly, using the static Bayesian Game theory to connect the resource nodes, the strategy can efficiently reduce failure rate of the resource nodes and shorten the query delay, thereby greatly improving the resource downloading rate.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Accurate Network Characteristics Measurement for Mobile Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network performance measurement is the most basic and effective way to quantify network performance indicators, understand and recognize network behavior. Delay, packet loss, and available bandwidth are the three key attributes for evaluating network performance. Although there are many methods for measuring these three parameters, there will be relatively large errors when they are applied to mobile wireless networks. It is mainly due to the unique channel characteristics and mobile randomness of mobile wireless networks, which makes measurement difficult. This paper proposes an accurate measurement algorithm suitable for mobile networks in terms of delay, packet loss, and available bandwidth. The algorithm can measure the fast-changing mobile wireless networks performance at high frequency, and fully consider the internal relationship of the three parameters. At the same time, it can dynamically and quickly adjust the sending rule of the probe packet according to the measured results, reducing the errors in the measurement process and improving the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Oil Mist Detection Module for Marine Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Oil mist detector is an important equipment in the early stage of the explosion of the crankcase for marine engine, and the oil mist detection module determines the working performance of the oil mist detector. By means of infrared light transmission principle, method and compositions of the detection module was extracted. Through analyzing the safety and reliability of hardware circuit module, real-time and accuracy of detector, overall scheme design of oil mist detection module was carried out. By analysis of principle and detection method oil mist, power and photoelectric conversion modules were designed and developed. Finally, laboratory verification of oil mist detection module was conducted, experimental results showed the module satisfied the design and function requirements.

articleTitle: Research on High-power Subdivision Measurement System based on GEMAC-IP1000B
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of the traditional electronic subdivision circuit with complex structure, high power consumption, single function, high cost, etc., a high-power subdivision method for electronic IC based on GEMAC-IP1000B is proposed. This technology can not only achieve high-power subdivision of circular grating signals, but also It has the advantages of high subdivision accuracy, easy operation, and fast speed. The principle of electronic IC high-power subdivision technology and the design scheme of high-power subdivision measurement system based on GEMAC-IP1000B were described, and the components of the high-power subdivision measurement system based on GEMAC-IP1000B were introduced in detail. Experimental prototypes were built, and different models were developed. Subdivision accuracy test at subdivision multiples. The test results show that the high-power subdivision measurement system based on GEMAC-IP1000B can not only achieve high-power subdivision of different multiples of the grating signal with high accuracy, but also has good repeatability and system stability, which fully meets the needs of practical applications.

articleTitle: Design of a Data Preprocessing Algorithm for Laser Sensor Used in Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the positioning and navigation system based on laser sensor has been widely used in inspection robot. Whether outdoor or indoor environments, large noise exists in the observation of laser ranging data. To solve this problem, taking LMS111-10100 laser sensor as an example, based on the analysis of sensor technical parameters, working mode and environmental influences, a pre-processing algorithm for laser ranging data including distance filtering, region segmentation and region smoothing is designed, which can effectively suppress noise in ranging data.

articleTitle: Study of Anti-collision Borehole Method While Directional Drilling Based on Double-objective Twin Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, an anti-collision borehole method for directional drilling in coal mine is proposed. Firstly, the absolute coordinate system is established by the zero-point borehole, and then the regression model is established by the double-objective twin support vector regression algorithm. Finally, the absolute coordinates of the predicted points are cut by the x axial direction, and the distance between the intersection points and the predicted points is obtained to determine whether there is a risk of borehole collision. Experiments show that this method can guide the construction of directional drilling under coal mine, improve the construction quality of directional drilling, effectively avoid the risk of borehole collision, eliminate the blind area of extraction and mining, and bring considerable economic and social benefits to coal mining enterprises.

articleTitle: Research and development of universal dialing method for smart cooperative router
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication technology, it is a general trend that multiple communication networks converge and co-exist to provide wireless communication services for people. In this case, especially for high-speed mobile environments, mobile network base stations have the disadvantage of incomplete network signal coverage, so smart cooperative routers have emerged. Because different operators and different systems need to meet their own conditions when dialing, and also consider the future development and the actual situation in the use process, this paper proposes a universal dialing method for smart cooperative routers to achieve the intelligence and universality, which avoids tedious manual operations and improves dialing efficiency.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Structures with Interval Parameters Based on a Radial Basis Function (RBF) Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this study, we introduce a radial basis function (RBF) neural network for the reliability analysis of structures with interval parameters. The RBF neural network is employed to approximate the limit state function of the structure. The training samples are generated using an optimal Latin hypercube design. The RBF neural network is trained with the samples, and afterwards linked with a Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate the reliability of a structure with interval parameters. The purpose of applying the RBF neural network to interval reliability analysis is to reduce the number of runs using finite element analysis, especially when the structure is complicated. A numerical example is used to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method. The proposed method can be applied to engineering applications.

articleTitle: A Space-polarization Nulling Method for Multiple Mainlobe Interference
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since the adaptive beamforming (ADBF) will cause great distortion of mainlobe beam when there are multiple suppressed interferences in mainlobe, we propose a new method to generate the mainlobe interference null for polarimetric array radar in this paper. By interference cancellation, we propose a criterion which can realize two different ways of nulling in the mainlobe at the same time. The mainlobe distortion of the beam can be reduced while the effective interference suppression effect is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Dual-band Filter with Adjustable Zero Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band filter based on an open-stub loaded open-loop resonators is designed. The second passband of the dual-band filter is obtained by tuning the length and position of the open-stub. In order to improve the out-of-band rejection of the filter, a spurline is embedded in the resonator, and an additional transmission zero is added. The theory has been verified by analyzing and simulating the dual-band filter with HFSS.

articleTitle: Research progress on single image rain removal technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The image removal of rain is of great significance to solve the problem of limited computer vision system under rainy weather conditions. Most of the current research work is focused on video rain. Unlike video rain removal, a single image has no prior time domain information, making rain removal more difficult. This article first classifies the existing single image rain removal methods, then introduces the typical single image rain removal methods, and summarizes the improvements, advantages, limitations and use scenarios of each method. Finally, the possible development direction of single image rain removal technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Multi-function Fast Networking Rescue Life Escort Benan Watch
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to realize the real-time perception of the status of vital signs of underground mine workers, reduce the potential hazards caused by diseases, and sense the physical condition of trapped miners during the post-disaster rescue process, detect the areas where miners are located. With NRF52832 as the control core, combined with ECG signals and photoelectric solvent pulse wave blood pressure measurement algorithm, real-time monitoring of the heart rate and blood pressure of miners is achieved; Bluetooth 5.0 combined with mesh networking technology is used to detect the area where the miners are located, which solves the current problem that coal mines cannot achieve monitoring of vital signs of operators and transmission line interruptions after disasters. Test results show that the device can improve the operational safety and rescue efficiency of front-line miners.

articleTitle: Dynamic of a two-grid coupled Cellular Neural Networks (CNN's)
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a two-grid coupled Cellular Neural Networks (CNN's) is proposed, which is composed of time-delay Chua's circuit with same lossless transmission line (LTL). Under zero-flux boundary conditions, the circuit is reduced to two neutral partial differential equations with time delay and diffusion. First, the equilibrium point of the system is calculated by its initial state and original function. Secondly, select the time delay as a bifurcating parameter, the stability and Hopf bifurcation behavior of the coupled circuit system are studied near the equilibrium point. Finally, the numerical simulation shows that the length of the lossless transmission line has an effect on the dynamic behavior of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Miniaturization of Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor Signal Demodulation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of miniaturization of fiber grating sensor signal demodulation equipment, a SOPC miniaturization verification system based on FPGA logic control is proposed and implemented, the utility model has the advantages of small volume, light weight, low cost, high reliability and powerful function, etc. The experiment shows that the system has high response speed and meets the requirement of design precision.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Implementing Commuter Ticket in Metropolitan Area around Jiaxing City Based on Awareness Investigation of Commuting by High-Speed Rail
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the fast developing tendency of urbanization, a bunch of metropolitan areas has been formed in China, some of the citizens are recommended or guided to live in satellite cities or other cities around so as to relieve the stress of ever-increasing population. Thus, the intra-city commuting trains connecting urban area and rural area, or the inter-city commuting trains connecting one city and other neighbor cities start to emerge. Jiaxing City, which is a city just located in the middle of Shanghai and Hangzhou, and also not far from Suzhou, has many inhabitants who work in those megacities or other satellite cities around these areas, may have large requirements on commuter tickets of intra-city or inter-city railway. Till now, specific research which focus on the feasibility of implementing commuter ticket in metropolitan area, especially in a city position like Jiaxing City between several megacities can still be hardly found. In this paper, based on awareness investigation of commuting by HSR, the feasibility of implementing commuter ticket has been done by employing normalization analysis method on the investigation data. Results has shown that the understanding of commuting by HSR is still limited, but 93.94% people support the HSR commuter ticket; and for the particularity of HSR commuting, it is only attractive to a small number of people at present.

articleTitle: Automatic Recognition Technology of Coping Style of Distribution Employees in Power Grid Enterprises Based on Gait Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a method to identify individual coping styles based on gait information extracted by OpenPost. By recruiting 414 front-line employees of power distribution posts, psychological index evaluation and gait data acquisition experiments were completed. After preprocessing the gait data, the time domain and frequency domain features are extracted, and the support vector machine is used to train the classification model for identifying the types of coping styles. The correlation between the predictive score of regression model and the score of self-report scale reached a medium level: in the dimension of self-blame, the correlation coefficient between the predictive score of regression model and the score of self-report scale reached 0.52; in the three dimensions of “problem solving”, “help seeking” and “rationalization”, the correlation coefficient could reach 0. The correlation coefficients of avoidance and fantasy were 0.48. The accuracy of the classification model in predicting coping style types (“mature”, “immature” and “mixed”) reached 83%. The results show that by machine learning method, the type of coping style of employees in power grid enterprises can be identified based on gait data.

articleTitle: Stability of a Class of Stochastic Dynamic Systems driven by Fractional Brownian Motion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Stability of stochastic dynamic systems is one of the most elemental concepts in control theory. In this article, we discuss the exponential p-stability of a class of stochastic dynamic systems driven by fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter 1/2 <; H <; 1. We obtain some new sufficient conditions ensuring the pth moment exponential stability of a class of stochastic functional dynamic systems by employing the solution operator, some inequality and the Banach fixed point theorem. Some well-known results are generalized and improved.

articleTitle: Research on Restoration Algorithm of Two-dimensional Degraded Image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The recognition and application of two dimensional code has been seriously affected by the image degradation produced during the process of acquisition and transmission of it. In order to fix that, analysis of the traditional image processing technology has revealed that adopting the advanced image restoration algorithm which is based on deep learning, building restoration model of two dimensional code by using the multilayer neural network, adding binary loss constraint on the basis of L1 norm, constructing the non-linear image degradation and restoration process can solve the too complicated structure, easily affected by noise and poor robustness problems caused of traditional method. The experimental result shows that this method has a good restoration effect on the degraded image of two-dimensional code, and also improves the recognition efficiency while shortens the network training time, more over it meets the needs of practical application of two-dimensional code.

articleTitle: Investigation and design of 4K ultra high definition television production and broadcasting system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to satisfied people's increasing experience requirements in video content, 4K ultra high definition (UHD) video has gradually replaced high definition (HD) video. The corresponding television (TV) production and broadcasting system is required to upgrade continuously for the TV station. This paper researches the different requirements of 4K UHD and HD video in the transmission system firstly. The differences between them from different indicators is also investigated. In addition, for the needs of the broadcasting TV industry, the paper gives the design scheme of 4K UHD video production and broadcasting system. The proposed design scheme can provide reference and guidance for different TV stations to design 4K UHD production and broadcasting system.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Generative Adversarial Network with its Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a new unsupervised learning algorithm framework, generative adversarial networks(GAN) have been favored by more and more researchers, and it has become a research hotspot now. GAN is inspired by the two-person zero-sum game theory in game theory. Its unique adversarial training idea can generate high-quality samples and has more powerful feature learning and feature expression capabilities than traditional machine learning algorithms. At present, GAN has achieved remarkable success in the field of computer vision, especially in the field of sample generation. Every year, a large number of GAN-related research papers are produced, reflecting the fiery degree of research on GAN model. Aiming at the hot model of GAN, first introduce the research status of GAN; then introduce the theory and framework of GAN, which analyzes in detail why the gradient disappears and the mode collapses during the training of GAN; then discussed some typical GAN improvement models, and summarized their theoretical improvements, advantages, limitations, application scenarios and implementation costs; Finally, the application results of GAN in data generation, image super-resolution, and image style conversion are shown, and the current challenges and future research directions of GAN are discussed.

articleTitle: Meta Analysis of Dust Heavy Metals based on Knowledge Map Visualization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Purpose: Explore the overview of dust and heavy metal research in typical regions of China and present them in the form of knowledge maps. Through in-depth research and visual analysis, a deeper understanding of the research hotspots of dust and heavy metals is expected to provide some help for later researchers. Method: The key words of “heavy metal exposure” and “heavy metals, dust” were searched in the Chinese Journal Full-text Thematic Database (CNKI), and the relevant literature on dust and heavy metals was gradually selected through extensive reading and intensive reading according to the literature inclusion and exclusion criteria. Relevant documents were summarized and compiled using NoteExpress software. General processing of data was performed by Ucinet and Netdraw software, and the correlation analysis was performed by SPSS25.0 and Stata software. Finally, RevMan software was selected to complete the meta-analysis. Result: A total of 815 documents were hit, and 67 documents were successfully selected, including 4063 sample sizes. A knowledge visualization map of dust and heavy metal health risk assessment in typical domestic regions was established, and the knowledge distribution of dust and heavy metal research was visually displayed and formed a focus. By studying clustering, we obtained the network map of keyword. Through Meta analysis, the analysis results of typical forest map and funnel map are obtained. Conclusion: For the study of heavy metals in dust, the research data in the Southeast area is relatively abundant. According to the results of the meta-analysis, the health risk assessment of typical dust heavy metals in basic research is credible. Degree is higher.

articleTitle: Stability of Neutral Stochastic Dynamic Systems with Markovian Switching
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Neutral stochastic dynamic systems have received broad attention, because the problems are not only great theoretical significance, but also have played an important role in many ways such as engineering control, finance, communication equipment, social science, etc. In this paper, we consider stability of neutral stochastic partial differential dynamic systems with Markovian switching. Some new sufficient conditions proving the stability in mean square of this neutral stochastic dynamic systems are derived by employing the fixed point approach. Some well-known results are improved and generalized.

articleTitle: Rock Image Automatic Annotation based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The automatic image annotation is a technology that uses deep neural network to extract features from the input image, and finally converts it into text description. It is currently one of the hot researches of explainable artificial intelligence. The thin section image of rock is an important data source in the field of geological exploration and oil and gas development. It can reflect the microstructure inside the rock. However, in actual research, if you only rely on manual observation to extract features from hundreds of rock images, it will affect the research efficiency and take time and effort. This paper uses GoogLeNet model in the deep convolutional neural network to implement the feature extraction of rock images, and also uses the LSTM model in the deep recurrent neural network to convert the image features into text features, and finally converts the rock images into text descriptions. The automatic image annotation technology of rock images based on deep neural networks not only realizes a step of converting rock images into text, but also assists scholars in the field of petroleum geology to realize efficient research.

articleTitle: The “Plug and Play” Parallel Operation Strategy for the Converter-Based Traction Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the research in the previous article, this paper focuses on the parallel operation among the multiple substations. Aming at the particularity of traction power supply systems where the resistance component can not be ignored, we improve the traditional droop control model, and consider the influence of resistance component. Combining with the topology of the traction substation, we propose the control scheme for the parallel operation among ac-dc-ac traction substations based on the impedance characteristics of traction network. A simulation model composed of three ac-dc traction substations is established and verified under no-load and load conditions. The results show that the system can achieve “plug and play” for the power supply and load, and distribute load flow automatically. The system shows good dynamic performance, and exists no impact current in the process of parallel operation. In addition, it can improve the traction network voltage level, and shows nice current sharing performance at the output side of the substation.

articleTitle: Development of Automobile Wheel Runout Measurement system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An online testing is going well on radial and axial runouts of vehicle rims to design a test and control system based on the industrial PC. With a specific structure of the tester as given here, a quick method can be available for rim runout test. The data acquisition card PCL-818LS is used to locate the rim, clamp the controller and capture data about rim runouts. The Visual Basic can program the controller. The Access2016 used as the storage database can automatically record various data available from the rim test. It enables the statistical analysis and printing functions. This system can ensure the testing accuracy to be 0.01mm, and the testing time to fall within 10 s/pcs. It is advisable to apply it to online rapid test on vehicle rim runout. It undoubtedly has a spreading and application value.

articleTitle: Application of Semi-Variable Coefficient Model in Prediction of Effective Throwing Rate of Throwing Blasting
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The semi-variable coefficient model is a very important kind of semi-parametric model, which has important applications in nonlinear problems. In this paper, the semi-variable coefficient model is applied to the prediction of the effective throwing rate of open blasting. Through the blasting samples collected in the mine, the various design parameters that affect the blasting effect are analyzed using a semi-variable coefficient model. Using the variable coefficients and constant coefficients of the various variables obtained by the semi-variable coefficient model to predict the effective throw rate, compared with other models, the average error of the forecast of the semi-variable coefficient model is less than 3 percent, and the prediction effect is better.

articleTitle: Short-circuit Failure Mechanism of SiC Double-trench MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the failure mechanism of 650V state-of-the-art SiC double-trench MOSFETs under short-circuit (SC) test. The experimental results demonstrate drain voltage (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\text{DS}}$</tex>) has a pronounced influence on the SC capability of the device, and different <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\text{DS}}$</tex> will lead to discrepant failure mechanisms. The gate-to-source oxide rupture is most likely to occur when a lower <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\text{DS}}$</tex> is imposed on the studied device. However, the breakdown of the gate-to-source and drain-to-source takes place simultaneously with a higher <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\text{DS}}$</tex>. And the reason will be discussed in this work.

articleTitle: Analysis of Millimeter-wave Radar for Monitoring Mountain Fire in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When a mountain fire accident occurs in the transmission corridor, the light causes the tripping of the transmission line, the heavy damage causes the burning of the iron tower, and causes a long period of unrecoverable major electric power accident. It is of great practical significance to monitor the mountain fire of transmission line and find out the dynamic state of the mountain fire in time. At present, there are many problems in the existing monitoring technology, which leads to poor results in field application. This paper analyzes that the power grid real-time fire monitoring technology of millimeter wave radar can effectively improve the accuracy of fire monitoring based on the realization of the automatic discovery, automatic positioning, automatic alarm, fire caused by tripping due to reduce accident rate, ability can effectively improve the transmission line against the mountain fire disaster.

articleTitle: Study on Decoupling Control System of Temperature and pH Concentration in Photoreactive Biological Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The photobioreactor system has the dynamic characteristics of non-linearity and large time delay, and the temperature and pH concentration of algae liquid have strong coupling characteristics. In this paper, taking the photobioreactor as the research object, a decoupling control system for algae liquid temperature and pH concentration is designed by combining neural network and decoupling technology. The simulation of the system based on MATLAB shows that the decoupling controller not only eliminates the interaction between temperature and pH regulation channel, but also has better control performance index.

articleTitle: Model-based fuzzy variable impedance sliding-mode control for trajectory tracking in physical human-robot interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper mainly presents a nonlinear fuzzy variable impedance sliding-mode controller. The controller provides asymptotic tracking for the robot end-effector in Cartesian coordinates applicable to human-robot interaction. Firstly, the forward and analytical inverse kinematics for a 7-DOF redundant manipulator were proposed. The optimal analytical inverse kinematic solution used redundant angle is chosen according to the joint angle minimum increment. Secondly, the controller based on dynamics model of the physical human-robot interaction was designed. Finally, using simulations with Matlab software, the effectiveness of the proposed controller is investigated.

articleTitle: BGP Anomaly Detection Based on Automatic Feature Extraction by Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Being the default inter-domain route protocol in the Internet, the security of BGP has attracted increasing attention. BGP anomaly detection technique aims to detect and alert anomalous events so as to minimize the damage it causes. In the existing related works, manually designed statistical features such as number of BGP update messages and AS-PATH length are commonly used for further anomaly classfication. However, features selected by researchers based on their observations on limited events may have limited generalization. On the other hand, neural networks have the ability to automatically extract features from large-scale raw data. In this work, we propose a novel method using raw BGP update data for both feature extraction and anomaly classification. The experiments on real world BGP data are conducted and the results show that our method has a promising performance compared with previous methods.

articleTitle: Research on DOA Estimation Based on Deep Learning for the Sea Battlefield
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional direction finding methods based on interferometer and spatial spectrum estimation occupy the mainstream of target localization. However, they strongly depend on the array manifold and are sensitive to array errors. The emerging technologies based on deep learning are data-driven, they are expected to compensate the disadvantages of the traditional methods efficiently. In addition, they exhibit better performance in universality and robustness. In this correspondence, the DOA (Direction of Arrival) estimation algorithms based on deep learning are discussed, including multilayer perceptron (MLP), convolutional neural network (CNN), convolutional recurrent neural network (CRNN), Auto-Encoder (AE) and so on. On this basis, the differences are studied as well. Finally, we summarize the challenges and propose the future developments.

articleTitle: Automatically Configuring the IP Addresses for Mobile Network in Collaborative Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Collaborative network deploys devices with multiple interface on moving objects to combine the operator's networks to transmit user data in parallel which can achieve bandwidth aggregation and provide stable network access services for users. Before the collaborative network can work normally, it is necessary to configure IP addresses for each interface of network devices in different geographical locations. Existing configuration protocols can only realize the automatic configuration of the IP address of single interface devices in the same network segment. If the network devices are configured manually, the complex and error-prone manual configuration hinders the deployment of the collaborative network. In this paper, we propose an automatic IP address configuration mechanism that can complete the IP address request across network segments and the automatic configuration of the IP addresses of multiple interface devices in the network. The simulation results show that the proposed mechanism can complete the automatic configuration of IP addresses in the mobile network in a short period of time and is well adapted to complex mobile environment.

articleTitle: A long-term visual tracking algorithm based on tracking-evaluation-learning-detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Long-term visual objec tracking is an open and challenging research topic. There is still a large gap between the existing research and the actual application requirements. This paper studies the long-term tracking algorithm, draws on the ideas of the TLD framework, and pays more attention to the role of confidence evaluation in long-term tracking. Taking confidence evaluation as an important part of long-term tracking, this paper proposes a tracking-evaluation-based -Learn-detect long-term tracking algorithm. The main work of this paper can be summarized into three aspects: First, an improved fully-correlation filtering re-detection algorithm is proposed. This algorithm can make full use of the output resources of the confidence evaluation model, effectively reduce the calculation amount during re-detection, and improve Detection efficiency. Secondly, the interaction and update strategies of the short-term tracker, confidence evaluation model, and re-detector in the framework are designed. The proposed strategy can effectively reduce the number of re-detections. Combined with the improvement of the short-term tracking model in the previous article, the reset efficiency of the tracker can be effectively improved after the target is lost. Finally, the validity of the framework is tested on the long-term tracking evaluation dataset.

articleTitle: Application Research of Blockchain Technology in Electricity Information Collection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Data security is particularly important in the field of electricity information collection. This paper proposes a electricity information collection model that considers secure access and interaction based on blockchain technology. Base on this model, a strategy for safe access of electricity collection equipment and secure transmission of electricity measurement data is proposed. Finally, experimental analysis verified that the model and security transmission strategy proposed in this paper can be applied to the field of electricity information collection, which can effectively improve the reliability of electricity information data and collection equipment, and ensure the safety of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on real-time distance measurement of mobile eye tracking system based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development and application of eye-tracking technology, mobile eye-tracking systems have become more widely used due to their safety and portability. We combine eye-tracking systems with real-time object detection using machine learning. We propose a method of wearing an eye tracker in daily life to obtain the distance between the eye tracking system and the gaze target in real time. During the visual interaction of the eye tracking system, in order to obtain the distance from the eyeball fixation target to the eyeball in real time, the world camera of the mobile eye tracking system pupil labs first collects the position and scale information of the detected target image in real time, and uses camera calibration principle, pinhole camera model and camera distortion model to establish a ranging equation, and then the feasibility of the real-time ranging equation is verified through a specified distance experiment. The total average relative error after de-distortion at the position of 50cm-75cm is reduced to 1.25%, and the highest accuracy-0.9182cm distance measurement can be achieved within the effective distance.

articleTitle: Research on Content of User Complaint Classification Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the online complaint content of Chinese websites users, we propose a user complaint classification model based on data mining. In this paper, we first use Bayesian network to segment Chinese words, then extract the emotional semantic features and content features of user complaint content, and finally construct the complaint content classification model by K-means clustering algorithm. Experiments are carried out on the open comment data set, and the validity of the user complaint segmentation and classification algorithm is verified by calculating the precision and recall rate of text segmentation and classification respectively. The experimental results show that this method has good classification effect and practical value.

articleTitle: Study of Mobility Patterns of Car Sharing Systems based on Public Web Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Car sharing is part of sharing mobilities based on automated systems with supporting software packages to provide users with array of service functions, and it emerges as a brand-new trip mode that is different from traditional public transportations. The current studies of car sharing system mainly focus on the aspect of service differentiation and technology realization, but rarely on car mobility patterns and user habits. In this paper, the concept of mobility patterns is derived from the perspective of automation system by implementing algorithms to collect car's information within a certain time frame from car sharing systems periodically. Mobility patterns are realized by the process of web crawler design, data processing and storage and data analysis on the platform of applying Python and MongoDB. Finally, utilization, parking duration and booking duration of car sharing systems are demonstrated to describe user habits in service-covered cities in Italy.

articleTitle: A Study of Management Information System for the Power Distribution Area Based on Intelligent Terminals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There are a series of problems in conventional management information system of power distribution area, for example, no concentrators lead to no shared data but some repeated functions and heavy workloads of operation and maintenance, and the like. In allusion to the above mentioned flaws, this paper, from the aspects of architecture of master station, intelligent terminals, and communication, mainly focuses on illustrating the need for information fusion to acquisition terminal, and then proposes implement approaches. It is designed to build a management information system for the power distribution area based on intelligent terminals, and it is expected to meet requirements of power marketing operation and power distribution. Facts show that with features of technical advancement and economic rationality, this system can serve as a reference for design and construction of intelligent electric meters reading system in the environment of smart grid. And most of all, it adapts to the development of smart grid technology under the regulate-control integration mode.

articleTitle: Communication Equipment Storage life prediction based on Accelerated Degradation Test
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional storage life prediction technology of communication equipment has slow data acquisition and long prediction period, which cannot meet the storage life prediction requirements of rapidly updated communication equipment. In this paper, we used the accelerated degradation test method, selected the key parameters that can best represent the performance of the equipment as the degradation quantity and set the degradation threshold. The degradation data of the key performance parameters of the communication equipment was rapidly obtained under the higher stress. By using the normal distribution model and the Arrhenius model, the communication equipment failure time was analyzed, so we can scientifically predict the communication equipment storage life in a short period.

articleTitle: Research on Rail Traffic Operation and Maintenance Alarm System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the application of big data and cloud computing technologies in the rail transportation industry, massive data needs to be analyzed and processed to meet the needs of daily driving and operation and maintenance. Taking the developed integrated system as an example, this article focuses on the application of the rail foreign object alarm system, which can be used as a reference for the facilities operation and maintenance of rail transit enterprises.

articleTitle: A Full-Automatic Archive Management Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of society, the number of archive is increasing day by day. The transmission of archive is a heavy work that archive staff must face every day. The labor intensity of accessing archive is high and the efficiency of archive access is low. At the same time, for some confidential files, we do not want people to have the opportunity to contact them. At present, in the service robot industry, there have been many cases of archive robot applications, such as integrated archive management robots, scaffolding or track-type archive management robots, etc., which have realized the use of robots to remove archives from archive cabinets and then transport them to management. The automated transportation of the docking window of the crew; however, in order to reduce the load of the robot, extend the running time, and ensure the stability and accuracy of the transportation, the management of the archive by the robot is basically limited to one copy at a time<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. However, in practical applications, the archive manager often needs to read multiple books, so if the robot can only grab one archive in a single transport, the operation efficiency of the archive management robot will be very low, which is not conducive to the promotion and application of the robot. Because of these problems, designing a archive management robot which can extract multiple archives at one time and run more stable, so as to truly realize fully automated archive management.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Lighting Control System for Classrooms Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The matter of energy waste has always been an unavoidable problem in the sustainable development of human beings. Because of poor awareness and weakness technology of environmental conservation, many classrooms and laboratories are very wasteful of power resources due to the use of traditional lighting systems. Focus on the problem that the traditional lighting control technology is used in the classroom lighting system. In this paper, a new intelligent lighting control system for the classroom is designed, based on PLC and industrial touch-sensitive screen. Firstly, a new intelligent lighting control system for the classroom based on PLC is presented according to the design ideas and the composition principle of typical electrical control system. There are three control modes: automatic, timing and manual, according to the needs of the classroom lighting system, Secondly, the lighting circuit and PLC control circuit are designed, in addition, the control principle of each component in the circuit is described in detail. Based on this, the control program of PLC is developed. The test results show that the system design is affordable, which can solve the above problems well.

articleTitle: An Acoustic QR Code that is Audible
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared to image-based QR codes, acoustic QR codes have their advantages. However, an acoustic QR scanner cannot recognize an acoustic QR code at a distance of more than 2 meters from an acoustic QR announcer. To this end, we propose a new kind of acoustic QR codes, called Audible Acoustic QR Codes (AAQRC), which employ humanly audible sound to carry users' information directly. At first, a user's string of characters is translated into a string of pitches. And then, some related algorithms can be applied to convert a string of pitches into a playable audio file. Thus, an AAQRC is produced, consisting of the audio itself. And AAQRC recognition has the opposite process of AAQRC generation. Compared with the existing approach for acoustic QR codes, the new method can recognize acoustic QR codes at a longer distance.

articleTitle: An Equivalent of Graceful Tree Conjecture
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This thesis have mainly discussed a tree is graceful if and only if its subdivision admits an almost-strongly graceful labelling,i.e., an equivalent of Graceful Tree Conjecture. We have done to the correctness of our algorithms by Procedure towards the zero-label, but we do not go to the computer implementation of these algorithms. Two examples show that the application value of equivalence of graceful tree is malleable.

articleTitle: Realization of Rocket processor based on FPGA acceleration card
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Heterogeneous computing of CPU-FPGA is the current research hotspot, and quite a few scholars have done in-depth research on FPGA heterogeneous computing, such as accelerated matrix multiplication, neural network, image analysis and other applications. This article deploys the RISC-V processor soft core ROCKET to the FPGA acceleration card, compiles the code to be run into RISC-V instructions, and runs it on the soft core processor implemented on the FPGA acceleration card. This method can avoid CPU- Frequent data exchange between FPGAs. This system selects ADM-PCIE-8K5 as FPGA acceleration card, implements ROCKET soft core processor under SDACCEL environment, and uses OpenCL C ++ to build a front-end server to call OpenCL API to communicate with ROCKET processor on FPGA acceleration card. Finally, the computing performance of the ROCKET soft-core processor was tested.

articleTitle: The Mechanical Property Analysis of Sonar Probe and Cable in Aviation Winch
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to accurately simulate the movement of the cable and the sonar probe during the operation of the aviation winch, the force on the cable and the sonar probe are analyzed based on the knowledge of mechanics in this paper, and the differential equation of the cable and the mathematical model of the probe are established. The nonlinear differential equation of the cable is deduced and solved by quasi-Newton method, thus the shape of each node of the cable and the attitude of the probe are iterated. Through simulation and its results, the influence of drag speed on the angle of the sonar probe and the shape of cable is analyzed, and the accuracy of the algorithm in the paper is proved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Collaborative Network Component Fault Management
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of collaborative network, in order to continuously adapt to new services and new requirements, the number of components of the collaborative network is increasing, and the collaborative network has become more complex. In order to ensure the reliability and stability of the collaborative network, this paper designs and implements the fault management of the collaborative network components, which can detect the faults of the network components, quickly diagnose the cause of the fault, and deal with it. This paper uses a combination of active polling and passive alarming to detect network component failures. By establishing a fault knowledge base model, a scheme of fault symptom influence factor and dynamic k value selection is proposed to realize intelligent fault diagnosis based on improved k-nearest neighbor algorithm.

articleTitle: Group Quality Evaluation Driven by Process Data and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A large amount of operation data will be generated in the working process of mechanical equipment. These data contain the quality status of the equipment. The quality status of the equipment group can be calculated by establishing a model to analyze a large amount of historical and current data. In this paper, the process data of equipment group is analyzed and modeled by Deep Belief Networks, so as to evaluate the group quality. Firstly, the multi-layer restricted Boltzmann machine is used to extract the eigenvalues of the multi-dimensional parameters. Then, the neural network is used to fit the nonlinear relationship between the extracted eigenvalues and the quality evaluation index, and then the group quality evaluation index is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the group quality evaluation model is verified by taking the set-up retarder depression test bench as an example.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Code Phase Synchronization Accuracy in GPS Spoofing
