The blockchain technology has been widely applied in industrial domains such as finance and logistics because of its key features of decentralization, data traceability, immutability and auditability which will greatly benefit the IoT system. In this paper, the foundamental of blockchain technology is summerized and the blockchain-based data protection architecture for IoT is proposed. The data transmission, storage and sharing schemes are detailed discussed and evaluated. The result indicates that the implement of blockchain technology will prevent typical attacks and bring benefit to data security of IoT.

articleTitle: Design of a Sleep Assistance System Terminalm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new type of sleep assist system terminal is proposed. The terminal is a wearable front end in a `machine learning-based sleep assist system', and is mainly composed of a sleep assist module, an ARM core control board, a WIFI module, a brain wave signal acquisition front end, and a power module. The design of the wearable front end proposed in this article innovatively uses bone conduction oscillators to play white noise and pink noise to aid sleep, and uses LED strips to gently wake up. After practical design, production and testing, the wearable front end proposed in this article can assist people with sleep disorders to better sleep. At the same time, the wearing front has been recognized by actual users and professional physicians, and has certain application value and promotion prospects.

articleTitle: Graphic Groups Towards Cryptographic Systems Resisting Classical and Quantum Computers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For building up new cryptographic systems of “resisting classical computers and quantum computers”, we introduce the every-zero mixed graphic group containing many every-zero graphic subgroups, and design a technique of encrypting networks by every-zero mixed graphic groups such that the encrypted networks form graphic group lattices. We show theoretical research for encrypting networks by every-zero mixed graphic groups, and provide particular graphic groups, such as planar graphic group, twin graphic group, dual coloring/labelling graphic group, matching graphic group, Topcode-matrix group and Topcode-string group. These groups are related many mathematical problems, in which some problems are NP-hard.

articleTitle: A network selection adaptation method based on power business and network characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the carrying quality of the power business, a network selection adaptation method based on power business and network characteristics is proposed. This method designs the network functional entity of edge management control center to manage the network selection, build the network service adaptation architecture including the scene adaptation, technology adaptation and cost adaptation for power business and network characteristics, and proposes an adaptation network selection method based on multi-attribute decision. The method proposed in this paper can effectively solve the selection problem of different wireless networks, give full play to the maximum value of power wireless private network, and make rational and scientific use of the public wireless network, and finally realize the high-quality bearing of power business.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High-availability PaaS Platform Based on Virtualization Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problems of the virtual platform failure migration mechanism under the cloud model and microservice architecture platform, the demand for redundant resources is large, and the failure recovery time is long. The key components such as the operating components, resource pools and middleware of the PaaS platform are analyzed, combined with virtualization The platform deployment application is practical. The PaaS platform high-availability architecture is designed to realize the PaaS platform high-availability deployment mode, which effectively improves the robustness of the PaaS platform and guarantees the business continuity of the application system running on the PaaS platform. This paper first analyzes the functional architecture and role positioning of the PaaS platform; secondly, it proposes high-availability design of operating components, resource pools and middleware, and at the same time maps the design to the physical deployment mode, the experimental results show that the design is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Improve MPTCP Transmission Performance Based on Quality Evaluation Algorithm in High-loss Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When using a wireless network to transmit data, especially for terminal devices that have a large amount of data to transmit, a single link often cannot meet their own needs. Therefore, compared to single-link devices, devices with multiple network interfaces have the ability to increase their own network throughput. However, wireless networks have high latency and high packet loss rates when moving at high speeds. And because of different operators, the link conditions are also very different. MPTCP has good parallel transmission performance under low latency, but under harsh environments, the performance of MPTCP rapidly decreases due to the influence of bad links. This paper proposes a work flow screening algorithm based on quality evaluation, which can improve the performance of MPTCP in high-loss network environments. The feasibility is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A multi-objective parallel detection algorithm for images of power transmission line corridors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The application of deep learning-based image recognition technology in remote monitoring of power transmission lines has improved the protection level of power transmission lines. However, since the current hidden danger detection is based on a single general algorithm, the accuracy of the detection results needs to be improved. In this paper, we proposed a multi-objective parallel detection algorithm for images of power transmission line corridors based on basic feature sharing. Firstly, we tested the detection effects of different detection algorithms on various types of hidden danger images, based on which benchmark algorithms are selected and optimized for various types of hidden dangers. After that, we designed a multi-objective parallel detection framework to implement the parallel detection of the above three detection algorithms. The experimental results show that the multiobjective parallel detection algorithm proposed in this paper can improve the detection accuracy, as well the detection speed.

articleTitle: Research on Flight delay Prediction based on Multi-Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the introduction of the concept of “Intelligent Transport”, in order to meet the needs of high accuracy of flight delay prediction in the transportation industry in the current stage, a short-term flight delay prediction model based on multi-model fusion is proposed in this paper. The data used in this study come from the official data of Ctrip. First of all, the model in this paper extracts and normalizes the urban weather information, time information, airline information, delay information and average information, and solves the over-fitting problem. Then, add L2 regularization to solve the over-fitting problem. Finally, the fusion prediction model proposed in this paper is used to cross-verify and predict the integrated data. The structure of the fusion model based on stacking proposed in this paper extracts the advantages of both random forest, XGBoost and LightGBM, constructs it by using the method of cross-validation, and combines multiple models to judge the results for secondary training. This method can not only enhance robustness but also better resist over-fitting. According to the experimental results, the prediction accuracy and stability of flight delay are improved by using this model.

articleTitle: An elevator scheduling optimization model considering the probability of taking the elevator based on Monte Carlo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the different probability of residents of different floors in high-rise buildings taking the elevator during the peak period of a day, this paper proposes an optimization scheduling model based on Monte Carlo Algorithm, making the existing model more accurate. The automatic counting module (ACM) based on infrared sensor is used to measure and record the number of passengers on different floors. On the basis of a large amount of data obtained from the research, the probability of taking the elevator is calculated, and the cubic polynomial fitting curve is generated based on the least square method, which is applied to the implementation of Monte Carlo Algorithm, and an optimized elevator scheduling model is obtained. At the same time, the optimized model and the existing model are compared in different aspects to generate visual comparison result. In the hypothesis of this paper, under the condition that the number of floors is 20 and the number of households on each floor is 50, the existing model will have a relative error of 10%-20%, and the number of passengers transported by the elevator below 10 floors will be significantly reduced with a relative error of more than 10%. At last, from the elevator scheduling model, a “one-to-many” model can be abstracted. We find that the model optimization idea used in this problem has certain guiding significance in dealing with some other practical problems.

Author Keywords: Automatic counting module based on infrared sensor

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of LCC-S Type WPT System Based on Improved NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Wireless power transfer (WPT) system is a typical loosely coupled, multi-parameter, multi-objective, and multi-constrained nonlinear system. Considering the constraints of system frequency bifurcation, soft switching control, actual output target, and device parameter ratings, this paper establish the multi-objective and multi-constrained non-linear programming model based on the time-domain differential equation method. Then optimizes system parameters with the improved NSGA- II genetic algorithm to maximize transmission power and efficiency. Simulation results show that the improved NSGA-II genetic algorithm can quickly find the global optimal parameters, and the obtained parameters make the system work at zero phase angle frequency, no bifurcation phenomenon, and maximize the transmission power and efficiency.

articleTitle: Deep Recurrent Q-Learning for Research on Complex Economic System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Complex economic system theory studies the socio-economic system in a dynamic, complex ideas. It is a more comprehensive economic theory established in non-equilibrium basis. At present, under the guidance of complex economic system theory, multi-agent based modeling and simulation is a universal research method to study economic system. However, the agent's behavior usually is fixed according to the simulation software's setting, which is difficult to explain the phenomena of feedback and emergence in the economic system. To address this problem, we first design a simulation economic system. In the system, there are two types of abstract micro economic agents, bank and enterprise. An improved version of Deep Q-Network (DQN), Deep Recurrent Q-Network (DRQN) was introduced to handle the decision-making of micro economic agents. Finally, we studied the observed behavior of agents in the experiment. The experimental results show that the behavior of economic agents can actively adapt to changes in the system environment and continue to be optimized with the accumulation of experience. Because of taking non-fixed decision-making strategies, this method can reflect the phenomena of internal feedback and emergence in economic system. Therefore, simulation based on DRQN is a simulation method that can better reflect agent decision-making in real economic system and it can play an important role in the study of complex economic system.

articleTitle: Research on The Anonymous Customer Segmentation Model of Telecom
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the ministry of industry and information technology's 2018 statistical bulletin on the communications industry, the net increase of mobile phone users reached 149 million in the year, bringing the total number to 1.57 billion. How to classify customers according to their value and put forward corresponding business strategies for different value customers has become one of the key issues in the field of telecommunications research. In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional manual classification, this paper adopts k-means clustering algorithm and SVD algorithm to conduct customer clustering in combination with operator data, and achieve the best classification of customers in the clustering process, and analyzes the behavioral characteristics of various groups. The results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the classification efficiency and accuracy of telecom users and reduce the errors caused by traditional classification. Finally, the conclusion and further work are given.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of two-phase Flow and Heat Transfer in an Axial Rotating Heat Pipe
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A numerical model is built to simulate two-phase flow and heat transfer performance in an axial rotating heat pipe. The volume of the fluid is used to describe two-phase flow and heat transfer characteristics. A mixed phase transition model with pure heat conduction and natural convection is studied. Based on mixed phase transformation model, the change rules are analyzed on the characteristics of two-phase flow and heat transfer such as heat load, filling, rotating speed and working medium. The results are compared with the experimental results in order to explore the mixed phase transformation model. The results show that the mixed phase transformation model is agree with the experimental results. The heat load and filling make little effect on the heat transfer performance. As the rotating speed increase, the heat transfer performance is enhanced. The physical properties of working medium have great influence on the heat transfer performance. It is concluded that the numerical model is a useful method to simulate the flow and heat transfer in an axial rotating heat pipe.

articleTitle: Tightly Coupled Algorithm of Visual Inertial Odometry and Magnetometer Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of mobile robot state estimation, multi-sensor fusion SLAM algorithm has been a hot topic of research. VIO is the core problem in multi-sensor fusion SLAM. In this paper, we propose a tightly coupled algorithm of VIO and magnetometer fusion. First, We built A multi-sensor experimental platform based on the ROS system. The magnetometer is calibrated using ellipsoid fitting correction algorithm. By evaluating the calibration results, the calibration algorithm accurately eliminates soft and hard magnetic interference. In the tightly coupled algorithm, an improved double vector attitude determination algorithm is used through gravity and the geomagnetic field vector. After the attitude is obtained, the attitude quaternion is used to construct the geomagnetic vector residual, which is integrated into the graph optimization. Experiments show that the algorithm proposed in this paper is robust and accurate.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Intelligent Analysis and Control System for Power Grid Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the high-speed growth of Grid scale and the promotion of power system reform, the operation pressure of State Grid of China increases, which puts forward higher requirements for the lean management and control ability of power grid operation. In this paper, an optimal intelligent analysis and control system for power grid operation and maintenance has been designed, which further integrates the information of regulatory cloud, big data analysis, robot inspection, and transmission channel visual monitoring systems. It can be used for the management and control of business scenarios and equipment status information in the whole process of operation and maintenance. The system can provide an overall overview of the main grid operation information of the power grid on the macro level, display the situation and information of single equipment on the micro level. As a result, the designed system can well support the development of intelligent operation and inspection business at provincial and municipal levels, and promote the transformation of transportation inspection mode from business process driven to equipment state driven.

articleTitle: Direct Current Transmission Based on Reliability Indicators System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The research implementation is divided into three main parts. The first part is the improvement and application analysis of the Direct Current reliability assessment index. The second part is the quantitative evaluation algorithm research and software development to evaluate the impact of the Direct Current system outage on system reliability. The third part is the application technology research of the grid reliability assessment tool in the maintenance and repair of Direct Current equipment, including the construction of evaluation indicators and the application test of the optimal selection of the Direct Current outage time. Based on the analysis results, an active planned outage mode is proposed and optimized. Equipment maintenance mechanism. The research team proposed the “active planned outage” maintenance mode and “active planned energy unavailability rate” indicators and verified the feasibility of the power outage maintenance optimization model with an example analysis. Finally, based on the three new indicators proposed by this research, combined with the development strategy, the research proposed an optimized Direct Current transmission reliability indicator system and explained the guidance and significance of the indicator system.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic division of trunk sub areas based on key junctions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Saturated traffic has become a common road traffic phenomenon in large and medium-sized cities. Traffic jams and the problem of oversaturated traffic pose new challenges to the traditional traffic control theories. The dynamic division is needed to divide the urban trunk line into several sub-sections., so as to realize the coordinated control of each section in the subsection., to balance the saturation of the sub area road segment., and to improve the efficiency of the cooperative control of the trunk line. Based on the analysis and characterization of key road sections., this paper studies the dynamic sub-region division method based on key road sections., and analyzes its feasibility with examples.

articleTitle: Scheduling for Heterogeneous Computing Platforms using a Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In heterogeneous computing platform interconnected by high-speed networks, the task scheduling problem has been extensively studied. Such systems promise to quickly handle computationally intensive applications with different computing needs. The HEFT algorithm is proposed to solve the task scheduling problem of such a system. The HEFT algorithm is simple but its efficiency needs to be improved. The basic idea of our method is to take advantage of genetic algorithms and HEFT algorithms while avoiding their disadvantages. The algorithm uses the HEFT algorithm to assign priorities to each subtask, while using a genetic algorithm to search for a task-to-processor mapping solution. The GHEFT method also designs crossover, mutation, and fitness functions suitable for directed acyclic graph (DAG) scheduling. Experimental results show that the GHEFT algorithm is superior to a non-evolutionary heuristic algorithm and a random search method in terms of scheduling quality.

articleTitle: A method of ROP decentralized layout
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Return-oriented programming (ROP)is a technique used to break data execution protection(DEP). Existing ROP chain automatic construction technology cannot effectively use program controllable memory area. In order to improve the utilization of memory space, this paper proposes a method of ROP chain fragmentation layout. By searching the controllable memory area of the program, a set of layoutable space is formed, and the overall ROP chain is segmented to add jump instructions at the end of each segment, thereby achieving a fragmented layout of the ROP chain. The prototype system ROP-chip based on S2E proved the effectiveness of the fragmented layout of the ROP chain.

articleTitle: Forgery Numeral Handwriting Detection based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Handwriting forgery detection is one of the hot spots in forensic science, and economic cases of handwritten forged numbers are increasing. At the same time, forgery identification of documents is an important evidence in criminal proceedings. For the problem of tedious and low degree of automation of manual document inspection, put forward a method for handwritten forged numeral detection based on convolutional neural networks. The experiment convened 50 volunteers and collected image samples of 6 types of forged and normal handwritings with 50 different brand pens, and established a total of more than 7,200 data sample sets. Perform parameter optimization on the basis of Alexnet, while training and testing the data set. The experimental results show that the highest accuracy rate of the six types of handwritten forged numeral recognition is 97.84%, and the average accuracy is 95.35%, which is better than the SVM feature classifier. It provides a new method for forgery handwriting identification.

articleTitle: Research on Fine Speed Adjustment of Expansion Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compressed air energy storage system(CAES) has the advantages of massive energy storage capacity, low pollution and long life. Based on the research of the operating characteristics of CAES, one system composited of peak-load modulation and frequency modulation is proposed, which makes full use of the large capacity of CAES, the rapid response of charge and discharge of the flywheel energy storage system and the significant frequency of charge and discharge. The CAES power station has the capability of self-starting through optimized design. After the failure of the power system, it can work as black start power supply. After adding phase adjustment valve and pipeline, it can realize the function of phase modifier, which has broad application and promotion space in the power grid.

articleTitle: Text classification model based on Word2vec and SF-HAN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development and application of the electric power Internet of Things, the number of electronic texts in the system has increased dramatically. However, due to inadequate system management and the complexity of information sources, the current electronic text management in power grid systems has the problems of disordered format, redundant information, and unclear classification. Aiming at these problems, this paper designs and constructs a power grid text classification model based on Word2vec and SF-HAN. The model uses the CBoW model in Word2vec to generate word vectors, and then uses the improved SF-HAN network to predict and classify the extracted word vectors. The accuracy of the method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: DGA fuzzy logic diagnostic method based on subordinating function
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the differences in the diagnostic characteristics and criteria of various methods, the conclusions are often inconsistent when using these methods to diagnose faults. when transformer faults occur, it is often a combination of multiple fault types, and the correspondence between fault types and fault symptoms is fuzzy. In order to describe the fuzzy correspondence in the complex fault diagnosis, the fuzzy mathematical theory is further introduced on the basis of the information fusion diagnosis method, and a comprehensive diagnosis method based on the information fusion and fuzzy logic is proposed. Among them, semi-cauchy lifting function was used as the subordinating function to replace the original binary function for boundary fuzzification of the criterion coding boundary. Furthermore, the coding criteria are expressed as subordinating function to form the subordinating correlation matrix. For diagnosis logic reasoning, “intersection” and “union” in fuzzy logic reasoning are respectively used to replace “and” and “or logic in binary logic to form multi-value output of fuzzy decision. The diagnosis results represent the probability of occurrence of different fault types.

articleTitle: Quality Detection of Laser Welding Based on One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: During the laser welding process, the occurrence of abnormal conditions can cause workpiece defects and make the products fail. Therefore, a real-time monitoring system required to detect the laser welding process for ensuring the product quality. In this paper, we develop a real-time laser welding data acquisition equipment that can measure the plasma density, laser light intensity, and melt pool temperature. In addition, a convolutional neural network is built to achieve rapid detection of laser welding quality. The experimental results show that the proposed method can quickly detect the quality of the laser welding process, and the average accuracy for the welding defects has reached 97%.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Input L-C Filter for Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Modeling, simulation and analysis are presented of the input L-C filter for buck converter in detail. The input current of the buck circuit is intermittent, so it is necessary to add an L-C filter to make the current passing through the switch continuously, which is helpful for the design of sampling and control. The state average method is used to model and analyze the input LC-buck circuit. Simulations carried on PSIM software to analyze and validate theoretical models. The simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Design of AGV combined positioning system based on characteristic error model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper puts forward an AGV combined positioning method based on laser and dead reckoning. First, the kinematics model of differentially driven AGV is established in this paper, and the system equation of state is obtained. Then, the data obtained by the lidar is used as the observation of the system, and the prior state is corrected by the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) to obtain the pose estimation of the system. Considering that the accuracy of EKF is closely related to the accuracy of the noise matrix, this paper implements modeling of process noise and observation noise based on environmental characteristics. Finally, EKF is used for data fusion to achieve high-precision AGV pose estimation. The experimental result shows that the AGV positioning combining lidar data and dead reckoning data using EKF can effectively improve the accuracy of AGV positioning.

articleTitle: Application of High-power Frequency Conversion Technology in the Fracturing Pumping Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The frequency conversion is a key technology of the electric fracturing pumping equipment. This paper briefly analyzes the technical characteristics of the current mainstream high-power frequency conversion system, aiming at the technical requirements of high-power, frequent load changes, high stability and reliability requirements of the electric fracturing pumping equipment, combining with the application of the frequency conversion system of the existing electric fracturing pumping equipment in China, studies the applicability of the frequency conversion system and puts forward development suggestions.

articleTitle: Similarity Image Retrieval Model based on Local Feature Fusion and Deep Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, this technology has unique advantages in feature extraction and feature nonlinear mapping, and it has become the primary solution to computer vision problems. Research on similarity image retrieval has turned machine learning into deep learning. Generally, similarity image retrieval systems based on deep learning first train a model for image classification, and then extract bottleneck layer features as image representation features for storage and retrieval. The problems with such a design are: the bottleneck layer features lose image detail information, and the features of similar images are not compact enough. This article aims to improve the method for the above problems. Adding metric learning to constrain the image features to solve the problem of inadequate compact image features; using local feature fusion features instead of bottleneck layer features as image representation features can express more image content. Finally, the effectiveness of the improvement proposed in this paper is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Cross-Field Construction Method of Chinese Tourism Knowledge Graph based on Expasion and Adjustment of Entities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Tourism involves comprehensive knowledge in many fields, such as geography, history, food, experience, etc., but now the result of knowledge retrieval and query of tourism topic is usually the knowledge in a single field, lacking effective correlation in different domains. Knowledge graph uses structured way or visualization technology to describe entity and entity relationship knowledge, and provides high-quality knowledge retrieval service for search engine users. However, now it is difficult to integrate field knowledge obtained from a variety of data sources to construct a domain knowledge graph. In this paper, we proposed a method from two aspects to construct the tourism knowledge graph. At one side, using specific tourism entities as seeds to establish different relationships such as historical association, food association, geographical association to integrate tourism entity attributes, increase the value of tourism entity attributes, so that the entity information in the tourism knowledge graph can be efficiently expanded; at another side, based on the process of cross-field entity adjustment with the help of annotation and scoring from domain experts and knowledge graph users, so as to construct the Chinese tourism knowledge graph efficiently and effectively. All these can lay the foundation for improving the retrieval and reply quality of tourism knowledge.

articleTitle: PVDF piezoelectric thin film force sensor dynamic calibration method based on negative step response method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Dynamic calibration problem of PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, this paper puts forward a dynamic calibration method based on negative step response method, established the mechanics model of negative step force calibration device, verify the PVDF piezoelectric film force sensor impact dynamic calibration method is feasible, negative step force calibration device was established by ADAMS model, and its performance is simulated, based on the negative step force calibration device set up negative step force calibration system, completed the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor's dynamic calibration. The experimental results show that the negative step force calibration device adopts hydraulic drive method, load input and output signal can be consistent, R square value is 0.9989, the linear error is small, high measurement precision, thus proving the piezoelectric thin film force sensor impact of quasi static and dynamic calibration method is feasible and of PVDF piezoelectric film sensor provides an important theory and dynamic calibration reference.

articleTitle: Research on Strong Supervision Algorithm Model Based on Blockchain in E-government
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the research and application of blockchain applied in e-government has been increasing. The characteristics of blockchain, such as non-tamper, verifiable and inspirable, have been well applied in confirming the rights, accountability, and assessment of government data resources, and other unresolved problems over the years. Well, the decentralized feature is naturally inconsistent with the strong central feature of the government so that the application of common blockchain technology in e-government cannot support the government regulatory mechanism effectively. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a strong supervision model of blockchain based on the Threshold Ring Signature algorithm (TRS). Further experiments show that the process and results of signature voting by using this model. Compared with the common blockchain, the strong supervision model can control the error rate of the chain information and increase the flexibility of blockchain so as to enhance the integration application of blockchain and e-government.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Blockchain Technology in Transportation Administrative Law Enforcement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the overall goal of rule the society by law, combined with specific requirements such as the records of the entire process of law enforcement in the three systems, the information such as law enforcement evidence plays a key supporting role. When design a law enforcement case handling information system, it is necessary to fully consider the collection, generation, storage, and transmission of law enforcement information how to ensure that the information is safe and reliable and not tampered. “Let law enforcement data runs on the blockchain” which use blockchain, big data and other related technologies to store and transmit information such as law enforcement evidence securely, and comprehensively improve the effectiveness and security of law enforcement data.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Maternity Interrogation Model Based on Ontology Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Most of the existing maternal information management is still in an independent system, forming a relatively serious island of medical information, a large number of diagnosis and treatment data, massive literature, etc. lack of effective collation, analysis and utilization. Based on the existing massive literature, guidelines and other data, using ontology technology and graphical modeling tools, using seven steps to build the intelligent ontology of pregnancy and childbirth, using Protégé tool to import pregnancy and childbirth cases to build the knowledge base, realizing the construction of the knowledge base of pregnancy and childbirth, building the intelligent diagnosis model of pregnancy and childbirth, providing data knowledge support for clinical decision support and intelligent diagnosis.

Author Keywords: Knowledge base of Pregnancy and Childbirth
Intelligent Consultation of Pregnancy and Childbirth

articleTitle: Research on Two-way Integration Business Process Reengineering under Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Big data is bringing great changes to enterprise management, which has a great impact on modern enterprise operation concept, business model, organizational business process, etc. After expounding the concept and characteristics of big data, this paper introduces the basic connotation and main methods of BPR of enterprise business process reengineering. Combined with the characteristics of big data, it puts forward the overall framework and idea of bi-directional integration of Enterprise Business Process Reengineering under big data, which is beneficial for the implementation of BPR of enterprise under big data.

articleTitle: Design of disaster detection robot vehicle model based on VR technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a disaster detection robot car model based on FPGA technology, camera sensor technology, wireless transmission technology, motor technology and other technologies are designed. It can conduct mode parameter configuration, image data acquisition, image data storage through SDRAM, image data transmission through NRF24L01 wireless transmission module, image display through headset VR equipment, and control the movement of model car through remote control. The system has the characteristics of fast data acquisition, clear and smooth image and fast transmission speed.

articleTitle: Radar Emitter Identification Based on Naive Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The aim of this study is to realize radar emitter Identification with high-efficiency. In this article, an approach based on naive Bayesian algorithm is introduced. For recognizing radar radiations, this paper utilizes Naive Bayes classifier for radar signal sorting, and selects the pulse parameters (direction of arrival, pulse width, pulse repetition frequency and radar frequency) as features for training the classifier. The paper also compares the method based on naive Bayesian algorithm with the methods based on artificial neural network, K-means algorithm and support vector machine. The performance evaluation shows that naive Bayes classifier can achieve a high recognition accuracy, and the approach presented in this article is proved to be more efficient.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hardware-in-the-Loop Real-time Simulation of Per-Unit Doubly-fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to overcome the lack of generality of traditional doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) system modeling, and to accelerate its rapid verification, a per-unit DFIG hardware-in-the-loop real-time simulation platform (HIL Platform) based on FPGA is designed in this paper. In this platform, DSP is used as the real controller, and the per-unit real-time models of DFIG and back-to-back inverter are built in FPGA. The integrated hierarchical and modular design method is adopted, and the hardware description language (HDL) Verilog is applied. Finally, under the same working conditions, no-load experiments and grid-connected power generation experiments were respectively carried out on the HIL platform and the full-physical platform. Based on the experimental results of the full-physical platform, the comparison of the experimental results shows that the HIL platform constructed in this paper has universality, real-time performance and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on diagnosis method of Interturn short Circuit Fault of dry reactor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Dry-type hollow reactor is widely used in power system, its operating environment is bad, the annual sun and rain also accelerate the aging of its insulation, it is easy to cause the dry reactor inter-turn insulation damage and burn down. At present, the main methods of live detection of dry reactor are infrared thermal imaging technology. DC resistance and insulation resistance are required in blackout test. These tests can not detect the inter-turn insulation of dry reactor. In this paper, the magnetic field and impedance characteristics of the interturn insulation damage of dry reactor are studied. The magnetic field changes and impedance characteristics of dry reactor are simulated by using ANSYS analysis software when the interturn magnetic field occurs in the end and middle of the reactor, respectively. A fault simulation platform for dry reactor is established, and a new method for interturn insulation detection is proposed.

articleTitle: A New Method of Wind Farm Clustering Based on Improved Fuzzy C-Means Clustering and MPSO
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Affected by many factors such as irregular cluster distribution, complex terrain and wake effect, the operation conditions of each unit in large-scale doubly fed wind farm are different. In order to improve the accuracy of equivalent output model of wind farm, an improved equivalent modeling method of doubly fed wind farm is proposed. Firstly, the characteristic state variable matrix which can represent the operation state of each unit is selected as the clustering index, and the improved fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is used to divide the cluster, then the parameters of the peer check-in model are identified based on the global optimal position variation particle swarm optimization algorithm, and finally the same group of units is equivalent to a fan. DIgSILENT simulation software is used for modeling, two dynamic conditions of wind speed step and three-phase short circuit fault. The simulation results show that the dynamic characteristics of the equivalent model are basically the same as that of the detailed model. Compared with the traditional single machine equivalent model, the accuracy of this method is higher.

articleTitle: Battle Damage Assessment for Building based on Multi-feature
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Assessment of battle damages is of great significant for tactical planning and provides the role of auxiliary decision-making for achieving accurate strike operations. In this study, we propose a robust method to detect damaged buildings using satellite images and building footprints before and after the event. This method uses multi-feature to detect the change of buildings, and has strong robustness to the change of light and local small deformation. By using the context model to describe the neighborhood of buildings, the detection accuracy is improved. The building footprint is used to accurately assess the changes in building level and form the neighborhood environment. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve detection accuracy and obviously better than single feature damage detection.

articleTitle: The theoretical calculation and output characteristic analysis of Yb doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The spectral characteristics of Yb-doped fiber laser are analyzed in this paper, and the absorption and emission cross sections of ytterbium ions in quartz matrix are given. It can be seen that there are two absorption peaks, 915 nm and 975 nm, respectively. The absorption coefficient corresponding to 915 nm absorption peak is smaller, but the absorption spectrum is wider. The absorption coefficient corresponding to the absorption peak at 975 nm is relatively large, but the spectrum width is very narrow. The advantages and disadvantages of Yb3+ doped laser materials compared with other rare earth ions doped laser materials are analyzed. It is pointed out that Yb3+ itself, due to its strong absorption and emission at 980 nm, disperses the pump power in the inner cladding of double cladding optical fibers and reduces the pump efficiency.

articleTitle: Perceptual Characteristics of Chinese Speech Intelligibility in Simulated Reverberant Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Speech intelligibility is affected by various interfering factors in a speech transmission system. Reverberation is one of the most common affecting factors. Subjective listening experiments were carried out in reverberant environment, and perceptual characteristics of Chinese speech intelligibility were analyzed. The function relationships between initial intelligibility, final intelligibility, tone intelligibility and syllable intelligibility of Mandarin and reverberation time were respectively established, and compared subjective syllable intelligibility scores with STIPA method.

articleTitle: Lightning Fault Location and Visualization for UHV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Lightning stroke is an important factor affecting the operation of the power grid. In order to improve the accuracy of lightning fault identification, the fault location is based on the information of the tripped lines and the lightning locating system. Real time fault information will be sent to the relevant staff through the fault visual notification system, which provides technical guidance for line operation and maintenance management, operation control, emergency disaster prevention and mitigation. The notification system minimizes the transmission line faults outage time caused by lightning, so as to guarantee the safety and stability of the power grid operation.

articleTitle: Electricity Corpus Construction based on Data Mining and Machine Learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the exponential increase of the Internet information, it is more difficult to collect and distinguish the useful information online. Corpus plays an important role in information retrieval and recognition. This paper proposes a corpus construction method based on data mining and machine learning for the energy and power industry. Firstly, the information data of the power industry are obtained by web crawler technology. Then they are stored in a database in structured manner. In order to construct a useful power industry corpus, the Long Short-Term Memory - Conditional Random Fields (LSTM-CRF) model are adopted for word segmentation, the Inverse Document Frequency (IDF) feature and Accessor Variety feature are used for new word discovery. The final electricity corpus consists of words, paragraphs and chapters. Based on the information retrieval and knowledge map, the built electricity corpus is demonstrated that is benefit to energy and power research.

articleTitle: Research on Dual-Arm Coordinated Trajectory Planning in Grid Coordinate Space
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the coordinated polishing of dual-arm robots is used for research purposes. The virtual space grid established by the raster method in the working space is used as the basis for collision detection. The coordinate space is used to further plan the trajectory of the dual robots, and MATLAB is used for simulation and simulation. The results show that the method can effectively avoid the collision of the double robotic arms and plan a reasonable moving trajectory.

articleTitle: An information security risk assessment method for cloud systems based on risk contagion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rise of cloud computing and cloud storage brings huge benefits to the information industry, but at the same time, related applications also face greater information security challenges. Therefore, this paper proposes a risk assessment method of cloud system information security based on risk contagion, which mainly evaluates the risk value of the whole system caused by a module being attacked as a risk source. In this method, the calculation of asset value is improved, and the permissions relationship is introduced into the calculation of risk contagion coefficient.

articleTitle: High Speed Signal Transmission Technology Based on Partial Power Channel for Capacitive Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to increase the signal transmission speed and reduce the interference between power transmission and signal transmission in Capacitive Power Transfer (CPT) system, this paper proposes a high-speed signal transmission method based on partial power channel by using orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation and demodulation technology. The circuit model of the system is established, and mathematical expressions of power interference voltage and signal voltage are deduced. The parameter design method of the CPT system is presented to reduce the interference and improve the speed of signal transmission without reducing power transmission capacity. The system experimental setup achieves signal transmission speed of 80Mbps with little interference to power transmission, which verifies the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Chaotic Fractal Characteristics of Crude Oil Market: Nonlinear Analysis Based on MF-DCCA
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we apply the methods of system dynamics to study the chaotic fractal characteristics of crude oil market. MF-DCCA is used to study the relationship between the spot and future crude oil market in order to analyze the noise while trading. Through MF-DCCA method, it is found that crude oil futures market is positively correlated with crude oil spot markets, and multifractality exists in the relationship. After analyzing the fractal source, we find that the long-range correlation of time series is the main reason for the multifractal feature of cross-correlation between crude oil futures and spot market.

articleTitle: Research on Small Vehicle Detection in Natural Traffic Scene
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of small vehicle detection in natural traffic scenes, this paper improves the SSD algorithm. We use K-means algorithm to cluster the Ground Truth of the KITTI dataset to make the default box closer to vehicle. Introduce the FPN framework to achieve the fusion of multi-scale feature maps, and make full use of the feature information contained in deep feature maps and shallow feature maps. And we use Focal Loss to reduce the weight of easy negatives examples, make training focus on hard examples, and improve detection accuracy. Finally, we implement data augmentation for small vehicles so that the training process can extract more small vehicle features to enhance the detection performance. The improved SSD has a mAP of 85.16% on KITTI dataset, which is 6.56% higher than SSD, and an FPS of 43.87, which meets the real-time detection requirements.

articleTitle: Overview of radar digital circuit fault detection technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The demand for weapons and equipment life cycle management has promoted the research and development of radar fault prediction and health management (PHM) technology, and radar has also evolved from ex post maintenance to condition Based maintenance (CBM). With the continuous development of information technology, digital circuits, with their excellent reliability and stability, account for more and more in radar. The Ball Grid Array (BGA) encapsulated Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) chip's solder joint failure is difficult to detect directly, and the failure of the FPGA's solder joint can cause serious damage to the radar. In view of this situation, this paper introduces several methods and principles of solder joint fault detection, and expounds its advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: A New Secure Model for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet of Things makes corresponding secure issues, such as invasions from the Internet, more and more concerned. And the growing quantity of IoT devices takes the IPv6 network into consideration. In this paper, we introduce a model to enhance the IoT device security. We use two mechanisms in this model. One is addressless, which hides IoT devices against invasions by using vast IPv6 address space. The other is watchdog, which supervises that the IoT device is under control correctly. By these mechanisms, we can ensure the security of IoT devices by vast address space in IPv6, verify the validity of messages for IoT devices, and avoid the IoT devices from security issues caused by lack of management.

articleTitle: SLAM Data Association of Mobile Robot Based on Improved JCBB Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Data association is an important step in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) for mobile robots. In order to ensure high association accuracy and reduce the amount of the association calculation, an improved joint compatibility branch and bound (JCBB) algorithm based on adaptive local feature association and adaptive Gauss mixture clustering is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the local association region is adaptively determined according to the current position of the robot, the measurement range of the sensor and the distribution of the current observations. Then, these observations are divided into several groups by using adaptive Gauss mixture clustering method, and standard JCBB algorithm is used to correlate the observations of each group with the features in local region. Finally, the eventual association result is obtained by integrating the optimal solutions of each group. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in this paper.

Author Keywords: joint compatibility branch and bound (JCBB) algorithm

articleTitle: Parameterized Drawing Design Method of Reluctance Resolvers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Drawing design is an important link in the development of reluctance resolver. The manual drawing of CAD drawings is tedious and time-consuming, and it is prone to omissions and errors. This paper uses VB language for programming, parametric design of the reluctance resolver drawings, and saves the drawing information with a DXF format drawings file, so as to realize the automatic drawing of CAD drawings. This paper gives the program principle and examples of key parts of the program. The program principle is concise and clear. The program in this paper can independently realize the expected function without relying on CAD software. It has the advantages of easy programming and convenient use, which can greatly save drawing time and improve design and processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Assignment of Satellite Communication Tasks Based on GA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Under the condition that satellite communication resources are limited, how to ensure the high efficiency to ensure satellite communication tasks is one of the key issues facing satellite communication systems. This article mainly introduces satellite communication tasks facing different task levels. Based on the improved GA algorithm, based on the analysis of satellite communication task parameter sets, it constructs satellite communication tasks through operations such as chromosome coding, fitness calculation, selection, crossover, and mutation. The dynamic allocation model and algorithm simulation are performed to compare the dynamic allocation and static fixed allocation methods. The simulation results show that the satellite communication task allocation algorithm based on GA algorithm can well satisfy the satellite communication task guarantees of different levels, and has certain reference value for improving the resource utilization of satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: Software Deployment Strategy Based on Performance and Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the current cyberspace field, the positions of offensive and defensive parties are extremely imbalanced. Aiming at the weakness of web virtual hosting in this paper, we combine software diversity technology to build a heterogeneous software variant library, and propose a software deployment strategy based on software performance and heterogeneity. Considering the attributes of the software and the structural characteristics of the network topology comprehensively, we implement the software deployment of each virtual site in the network topology. Our analysis shows that our deployment strategy can make the heterogeneity and performance of the entire network topology reach a high level, and further improve the security of complex network environment. Finally, we use the real-world network topologies to verify the feasibility of our method.

articleTitle: Design of Crimping On-line Detection System for Wet Coating of Synthetic Leather
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the cloth edge crimping defects in synthetic leather wet coating line and the shortcomings of the existing manual monitoring methods, this paper develops a crimping on-line detection system based on machine vision for manufacturing enterprises. The system adopts modern advanced control technology, computer technology and sensing technology, and collects the image of the detected object through the imaging acquisition module composed of industrial camera, industrial lens and light source in the way of light, machine, electricity and software. Image processing software based on Windows operating system is developed, and the images are processed and displayed to realize the real-time detection of the crimping defects of the wet coating line. The application of the system will enable synthetic leather manufacturers to further improve production efficiency and product quality.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Method Based on Clustering Undersampling and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Detecting abnormal traffic is important for network management. Aiming at the problem of data imbalance in traffic anomaly detection, an undersampling method based on clustering is used to process imbalanced data sets. Set the number of clusters in normal flow samples to the number of abnormal flow samples, and then use the cluster center nearest neighbor sample points as retained sample individuals to achieve the purpose of under-sampling. The effective fusion of clustering undersampling and Adaboost algorithm makes the algorithm pay more attention to samples that are difficult to judge in the data set, and further improves the effect of network traffic anomaly detection. K-RUSboost algorithm is simulated in Moore data set and iscxvpn2016 data set. The experimental results show that using this algorithm improves the recall rate of abnormal flow and maintains the false positive rate of abnormal flow at a relatively low level.

articleTitle: A sentence sentiment classification method based on Self-supervised and Self-attention
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to extract the semantic and grammatical information of sentences more effectively, this paper proposes a sentence sentiment classification method based on Self-supervised and Self-attention mechanism (SS-SAtt-BiLSTM). In this method, BiLSTM network is used to extract the feature of text context relationship, and self-supervised (SS) learning mode is introduced into the supervised sentence representation model. The sentence itself is used as the label data information of current words, and an improved self-attention mechanism (SA) is used to calculate the attention weight of each moment. The experimental results of MR and Stanford sentient treebank (sst-5) data sets show that this method reduces the dependence on tagged data, and the improved self-attention mechanism enables the model to learn more key features of sentences and improve the classification performance.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection based on feature extraction of unknown protocol payload format
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Intrusion detection technology is mainly divided into two categories: Misuse Detection and Anomaly Detection. Misuse Detection cannot detect unknown attacks, and the rate of false negatives is high. Abnormal Detection's false alarms rate is high, and practical applications are few. The current mainstream intrusion detection systems (IDS) consider application scenarios that are common network environments and pursue high cost performance. To make up for the deficiencies of IDS, this paper proposes an attack detection in special network, which exist a large number of user-defined unknown protocols. By extracting features from the unknown protocols, the characteristics of the unknown protocol format are obtained, and anomaly detection is performed based on this characteristic. This paper first demonstrates the feature extraction technology of unknown protocols, explains mathematically how to obtain the protocol format information of each layer of the unknown protocol, then conducts simulation experiments and compares the detection results with ordinary misuse detection and anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Method for Heterogeneous Identification Resolution Technology of IoT Based on Hyperleger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Internet of Things identification refers to the name tags used to identify different Internet of Things objects and is the basis and prerequisite for information communication and various applications. In the Internet of Things identification analysis related technology, due to the lack of a unified standard, there are multiple identification types. These identification analysis services cannot be connected, and are prone to single-point failure and single-point control. This will lead to the inability to make full use of the Internet of Things resources and limit the rapid development of the Internet of Things. In this paper, we build a heterogeneous identity resolution service node peer-to-peer network structure by using the multi-chain characteristics of Hyperledger Fabric. By introducing the Geni coefficient, we build a competitive incentive mechanism based on the reputation value of resolution nodes to ensure fairness among resolution nodes. And we propose a heterogeneous identity resolution service mechanism. Finally, we design experiments to verify the effectiveness and reliability of heterogeneous identity resolution services based on Hyperledger Fabric.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Processing Method of Measurement Information Based on Multi-Source Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of tracking accuracy and servo performance degradation caused by the lagging measurement information and amplitude mismatch of the heterogenous sensor in the photoelectric pod system, a high-precision comprehensive processing method based on multisource sensor measurement information is proposed in this paper according to the typical control loop of the photoelectric tracking system. Firstly, based on the optimal estimation theory, the output miss distance of the tracker is pre estimated to solve the problem of insufficient estimation of target position accuracy and high speed noise. Then, in view of the information mismatch between the angle sensor and the angular velocity sensor, the nonlinear tracking differentiator is used to get the angular velocity of the angle sensor and make a difference with the measured value of the angular velocity sensor. Finally, the amplitude and delay of the measurement information are adjusted adaptively according to the size of the root mean square of the difference value until the difference value is minimized. The algorithm was applied to the stable tracking experiment of a certain type of pod, and the results showed that the tracking accuracy increased from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$92\ \mu \text{rad}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$54\ \mu \text{rad}$</tex>, which significantly improved the tracking accuracy of the system and proved the effectiveness of the algorithm. The method proposed in this paper can be quickly applied to other photoelectric systems, and has reference significance[1].

articleTitle: Research and Application of SM9 in the Ubiquitous Electric IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the reform of the power system, relying on new technologies such as big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, the IoT, and blockchain, the construction of the ubiquitous electric IoT has promoted data fusion in all aspects of the system and broke the isolation of data island. However, due to the large scale of system access, the complexity of business operations, and the increasing number of system vulnerabilities and vulnerabilities, it is difficult for traditional network security technologies to ensure system security. The certificateless security mechanism based on domestic passwords can effectively solve the security problems brought by massive terminal access and ensure the stable operation of the power system. In order to meet the security requirements of energy Internet information interaction, this article proposes the SM9 cloud service constructed by converged cloud technology for large-scale terminal interconnection scenarios, and integrates the challenge handshake authentication protocol (CHAP) to prevent Identity authentication affected by replay attacks, improving the security management and control capabilities of terminal access, and comprehensively supporting the construction of world-class energy Internet companies with excellent competitiveness.

articleTitle: Research on channel estimation based on DFT algorithm in CO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Channel estimation, as a key technique, has a significant impact on the performance of coherent optical Fiber-optic communication system, by transmitting the known data at the transmitter to the receiver, the original signal can be recovered from the receiver by equalizing the effects such as loss, dispersion, nonlinearity, etc. The coherent optical OFDM system is introduced in this paper, and the simulation platform of coherent optical OFDM system is built by using optisystem and Matlab software, the simulation test is carried out on this platform. The results show that the improved DFT algorithm can improve the performance of coherent optical OFDM system. The improved DFT algorithm and DFT algorithm have 1 dB optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) gain when BER is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>, and have3 dB OSNR gain compared with LS algorithm.

articleTitle: English-Vietnamese machine translation model based on sequence to sequence algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Machine translation is a task in natural language processing that uses computers to convert between different languages. This article introduces an original seq2seq model experiment on the English-Vietnamese data set. By adding the attention mechanism and comparing the results of the model, we find that the attention mechanism can greatly promote machine translation. Using seq2seq and attention mechanism models to achieve the basic functions of the machine model, and has outstanding performance in the experimental results. Using multi-bleu-perl to analyze, the results show that the attention mechanism shows good performance on Vietnamese machine translation tasks.

articleTitle: Laplacian Generative Adversarial Networks for Multi-Scale Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Single-image super-resolution, aims to reconstruct images from low-resolution to high-resolution and super-high-resolution, so as to improve image clarity and visual effects. Based on the principles of generating adversarial networks and image pyramids, a LapSRGAN is proposed to compromise the merits of Laplacian Pyramid Generative Adversarial Network(LapGAN) and Laplacian Pyramid Super-Resolution Network(LapSRN). LapSRGAN is an end-to-end image reconstruction network, which can achieve double and quadruple high-quality, high-resolution reconstruction of the original image. The proposed LapSRGAN is trained with multiscale discriminators and perceptual loss which calculated on feature maps of image. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on bench mark datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Extracting Online Recruitment Information Based on BiLSTM-Dropout-CRF Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To improve the feature learning based on different job requirements, BiLSTM-Dropout-CRF (BLDC) model was proposed. Firstly, the original sentence sequences are imported into the embedding layer to obtain the word vectors. Then, BiLSTM and the dropout layer are used to learn the contextual information and key features. Finally, the CRF layer is used to accomplish the optimal sequence labeling and complete the training. For evaluating the model performance, precision, recall rate and F1 score are used to assess the extraction accuracy. The result shows that compared with traditional models, the F1 score of BLDC model severally increases 4.4% and 1.5% averagely based on two datasets about different industries and positions. It adequately illustrates that the effectiveness of online recruitment information extraction has been promoted.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Prediction Model of Blasting Vibration Speed by BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the feasibility and accuracy of the prediction model of blasting vibration velocity, a modified BP neural network prediction model of blasting vibration velocity was proposed by combining factor analysis method and BP neural network method. Select the case data to test the improved BP neural network network blasting vibration velocity prediction model. The test results: the relative average error between the predicted value and the actual value of the 14 training samples is 7.37%, and the relative error of the five prediction samples is 2.40% 2.23%, 3.68%, 2.39%, and 2.17% are all less than 10%, which proves that the improved BP neural network prediction model has better prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of the Five-phase S-curve Velocity Model on FDM Three-dimensional Printer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The essence of the FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling) three-dimensional printing control technology is that the extrusion nozzle completes point-to-point motions by stepper motors according to a specified trajectory from G-codes. In the implementation of the G-code feeding, the stepper motor plays a very important role, not only providing power for the mechanical structure that drives the movement of the extrusion nozzle, but also directly participating in the control of the nozzle position. Allowing the speed of stepper motors to undergo a low-to-high acceleration process is a necessary process in the actual application environment, and the speed planning strategy will directly influence the molding quality and efficiency of the 3D model. This paper introduces the five-phase S-curve velocity model to control and plan the frequency of stepper motors and how to apply the model on the environment of 3D printer. Furthermore, the look-ahead algorithm is introduced to make the speed planning of multiple G-code paths more efficient. The experiment result proves the reduce on the effects of flexible impacts and the improvements on the surface quality of finished 3D models.

articleTitle: Disease suppressing on correlated multiplex networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Social support is indispensable in controlling the spreading of infectious diseases. How to use effectively the limited resources in suppressing disease spreading is a subject of great challenge. In this paper, a novel model of resource allocation in suppressing is proposed that is comprised of the local information of both network structure and spreading state in physical contact subnetwork. Besides a resource based disease spreading model is also proposed. Through extensive simulations on both uncorrelated two-layer multiplex networks and networks with inter-layer degree correlations we find that when only consider the impact of local network structure on uncorrelated multiplex network, there is a worst value, at which the threshold reaches lowest and infected density reaches maximum. When only consider the impact of local information of spreading state we observed that there is also a worst value. In addition, when the inter-layer degree correlation is positive, we observe that when the bias parameter is smaller than zero, resources in layer social layer should be allocated preferentially to nodes with relatively larger LSD. However, when the bias is larger than zero, there is a worst value of the bias parameter, at which resources in layer social layer should be allocated preferentially to nodes with larger LSD. At last, when the inter-layer correlation is negative, we observe that resources in layer social should be allocated preferentially to the nodes with larger value of LSD.

articleTitle: A 180nm CMOS fully digital Indirect Time-of-Flight SOC based on SPAD
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the demand of 3D vision, we proposed a fully digital indirect time-of-flight SOC based on single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD). The single pixel unit of the SOC consists of an analog SPAD pixel module and a digital phase integration processing module and is designed by 180nm CIS CMOS technology. In this design, an all-digital design structured is used to collect phase information at high speed in an attempt to improve the frame rate of the sensor. We also propose a new quenching circuit that speeds up the detector quenching and controls the reset time to reduce the damage rate of SPAD.

articleTitle: Design and Production of Tracking System based on OpenMV Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the OpenMV open machine vision module, the image recognition and tracking system is studied. The designed intelligent three wheel car is based on STM32F765VI single chip microcomputer, combined with ov7725 photosensitive element, L298N motor drive module, motor and other peripheral equipment. The algorithm of gray scale, filter, binarization, dilate and erode is used to process the image. With the help of OpenMV IDE software and OpenMV's own image processing library, the small ball tracking function is realized by PID algorithm. Setting different experimental environment to test the tracking system, the car can accurately and quickly track the small ball of a specific color block.

articleTitle: Research and design of tethered multi-rotor unmanned airborne system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 5th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
